content_preview: 【物价上涨拖累消费者信心 日本政府两年多来首次下调消费评估】金十数据11月24日讯，随着物价上涨持续影响消费者信心，日本政府11月两年多来首次下调对消费支出的评估。日本政府称，消费“似乎在回升过程中出现停滞”，而10月份的表述则是消费“呈现回升迹象”。随着对美国和欧盟的出货量增加，日本政府自6月以来首次上调出口评估，称出口“整体呈回升态势”。此前表示出口复苏出现停滞迹象。政府自9月以来首次上调工业生产评估，称工业生产“整体正在回升”，主要受到半导体制造设备等生产机械产量增长的带动。日本政府维持对经济的总体判断，认为经济“整体温和复苏”，同时继续提醒关注中东局势发展的影响。日本政府表示，就业和收入状况改善预计将支撑经济温和复苏，但同时警告伊朗战争以及金融市场波动可能带来影响。

title: 【日本央行前委员：明年或继续加息 但消费疲软恐引发政治阻力】日本央行前政策委员会委员足立诚司周二表示，日本央行可能还需要
content_preview: 【日本央行前委员：明年或继续加息 但消费疲软恐引发政治阻力】日本央行前政策委员会委员足立诚司周二表示，日本央行可能还需要多次加息以抑制通胀，但由于消费疲软，加息计划可能面临政治阻力。尽管政府燃油补贴缓解了家庭面临的价格压力，但随着企业将原材料成本上涨转嫁给消费者，预计明年通胀率仍将高于日本央行2%的目标。他预计，日本央行可能在12月或明年1月将利率从目前的1.25%上调至1.5%。为防止通胀超出目标水平，明年可能进一步将利率提高至1.75%或2.0%。但他警告称，高市早苗政府及其顾问可能对进一步加息施加阻力。“利率上升带来的压力可能首先通过房贷利率上升传导至家庭，这可能不是政府乐于看到的情况。政府愿意容忍多大程度的压力，可能成为决定日本央行明年加息节奏和时机的关键因素。”

title: 日本LNG发电点火价差战后首次转正，现货采购需求或迎拐点
content_preview: 日本LNG发电点火价差战后首次转正，现货采购需求或迎拐点 彭博数据显示，衡量日本使用现货LNG发电盈利空间的实物点火价差（JEPX现货电价与JKM现货LNG发电成本之差）7日均值自2月下旬伊朗战争爆发以来首次转正。 转折主要由电价快速上涨推动：11月23日举行的日前电力拍卖中，日本次日交付的全国批发电价升至37.5日元/千瓦时，创2022年8月以来最高水平，寒冷天气预期、供暖需求增加及云层遮挡导致光伏出力下降共同推高电价。 此前日本因煤电成本优势而减少LNG使用，近30日LNG到港量同比下降约9%。若价差持续为正，电厂可能重新增加现货LNG采购，与欧洲买家争夺冬季货源，进一步加剧亚洲现货市场供应竞争。

title: Japan Cuts Consumer Spending Assessment for First Time in More Than Two Years as Prices Weigh on Confidence
content_preview: Japan Cuts Consumer Spending Assessment for First Time in More Than Two Years as Prices Weigh on Confidence Japan cut its assessment of consumer spending in November for the first time in more than two years, saying it appeared to have stalled in its recovery as rising prices weighed on confidence. In October, the government said spending showed signs of recovery. It raised its export assessment for the first time since June, saying exports were broadly recovering as shipments to the U.S. and EU increased, after previously warning that the recovery appeared to be stalling. The government also raised its industrial production assessment for the first time since September, saying output was broadly recovering, led by gains in production machinery, including semiconductor manufacturing equipment. Its overall economic assessment was unchanged, with the economy recovering moderately. The government said improving employment and income conditions should support a moderate recovery, while flagging risks from developments in the Middle East, the Iran war and financial market volatility.

title: 金巴斯集团计划将主要上市地迁至纽约 加剧伦敦上市公司外流局面
content_preview: 【金巴斯集团计划将主要上市地迁至纽约 加剧伦敦上市公司外流局面】财联社11月24日电，英国餐饮公司金巴斯集团计划将主要上市地由伦敦迁至纽约，令英国股市面临的不利局面进一步加剧。金巴斯周二表示，迁移将于2028年完成。金巴斯将保留伦敦作为第二上市地，并将就这项决定征询股东意见。按市值计算，金巴斯是富时100指数前20大成分股之一。它是最新一家为寻求更充裕的流动性和更高估值而转投美国的伦敦上市知名企业。其他例子包括Wise Plc、Ashtead Group Plc、CRH Plc和Flutter Entertainment Plc。英国最大制药商阿斯利康公司的股票2月开始在纽约证券交易所交易，反映出美国市场对该公司日益重要，也是公司为吸引更多投资者而采取的一项举措。

graduate_impact: 双碳政策下新能源产业链技能需求扩张，期货工具创造金融岗位，但行业竞争加剧需警惕泡沫。

title: 浙江宣传称中国消费降级是伪命题 被质疑偷换概念
content_preview: 中共浙江省委宣传部平台“浙江宣传”发文称中国消费降级是伪命题，称中国正经历的不是整体性消费降级，而是消费结构调整和消费增长动能转换，指中国人“不敢消费、消费能力下滑”的结论，本质上是一种认知误区。 这篇发表于本周一（11月23日）的文章，从不同维度，将通常被视为消费降级的现象，定义为消费转型。例如，虽然线下商场人流量减少、实体门店热度不如从前，文章称，这只是消费场景的迁移，绝非消费活力的衰退。奢侈品、名牌销量下降，文章指出，这是从物质消费转向精神和体验消费。 证明旧消费退潮的同时，文章说，新的消费增长点正在成型，支撑起消费市场的活力。例如可穿戴智能设备、新能源汽车等绿色智能消费持续增长；文旅、演出、健身、康养等体验服务消费兴起；国产品牌替代部分溢价进口商品；露营、轻养生、知识付费等细分小众消费活力释放。 不过，文章也说，新消费业态目前体量偏小，尚未完全形成规模化、常态化的消费支撑力。 文章称，部分人形成消费降级的观感，“并非来自整体消费数据，而是和日常接触电商平台所获得的消费体验存在关联” 。 例如，平台算法向低价商品倾斜、电商平台常态化的补贴、低价团购等模式，“表面看是顺应消费者需求的正常市场行为，实际上又形成另一种形式的消费主义陷阱，同时还助推了‘消费降级’论调传播”。 文章说，“很多人将这种平台规则倒逼的低价消费行为，误读为市场整体消费降级，局部的电商低价内卷演变为更广范围的消费认知偏差”。 最后，文章也说，中国很大，“一部分人受工作变动、收入波动等因素影响，消费水平达不到自身期待甚至影响生活质量，这类情况是真实存在的”，但部分人的感受与评价不能被放大成评判整个中国消费、中国经济的核心依据。 这篇文章传播广泛，阅读超过10万次，转发1万2000次。评论区首条点赞数量超过2700次的评论称，“但是从我身边来看，不止是降级，甚至是减少消费了，不消费了”。对此，浙江宣传回复，“减少（不必要的）笑疯了吧，生活必需品该买还是得买点”。 评论区首条点赞数量超过2700次的评论称，“但是从我身边来看，不止是降级，甚至是减少消费了，不消费了”。（浙江宣传公众号） 知乎上认证为中国科学院工学博士的答主“苏呷子”说，文章很精彩，“把一个经济问题偷偷改造成了文字游戏”，把“消费降级”改名为“消费结构升级”，把“买不起”改成“不想买”，把“少花钱”改成“理性消费”。 该答主还说，“选择的自由和没有选择的余地，是两回事。真正值得警惕的，恰恰是文章把这两者混为一谈”；“最怕的不是老百姓开始精打细算，而是有人把老百姓不得不精打细算，包装成了一场伟光正的观念革命”。 中国国家统计局数据显示，今年前10个月，全国社会消费品零售总额同比仅增长1.0%，达41.65万亿元人民币（8.07万亿新元）。其中，10月单月同比增长0.4%。同期，服务零售额同比增长4.9%，明显高于商品零售额0.9%的增幅；涵盖商品和服务的零售总额则同比增长2.5%。 北京、上海两大一线城市的消费表现更为疲弱，社零均陷入负增长。

title: 【中金辐照：拟定增募资不超8亿元 控股股东参与认购】中金辐照公告称，公司2025年度向特定对象发行A股股票相关事项已经董
content_preview: 【中金辐照：拟定增募资不超8亿元 控股股东参与认购】中金辐照公告称，公司2025年度向特定对象发行A股股票相关事项已经董事会、临时股东会审议通过及国资部门批准，尚需深交所审核通过并经中国证监会同意注册后方可实施。本次发行对象为包括控股股东中国黄金集团在内不超过35名特定对象，中国黄金集团拟以1亿元或实际募资额50%的孰低值认购。本次发行拟募资不超过8.00亿元，扣除发行费用后将用于长沙、合肥、嘉兴灭菌项目、钴源采购及补充流动资金。

title: Hog prices fall sharply; turning point may come next year
content_preview: Hog prices fall sharply; turning point may come next year China’s national hog price averaged 10.77 yuan/kg in October, down 5.7% MoM and 14.3% YoY, according to the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs. Breeding-to-market farms lost about 200 yuan per hog sold on average as ample supply and high capacity weighed on prices. Seasonal demand for cured pork and sausage, along with stockpiling ahead of New Year and Lunar New Year, is lifting consumption. Earlier cuts to the breeding sow herd are expected to curb growth in marketings and ease oversupply. Zhu Zengyong, a researcher at the Chinese Academy of Agricultural Sciences, said supply and demand should improve markedly around Q2 2027 as those cuts take effect, supporting a steady, moderate recovery in hog prices. Unlike previous cycles, the current downturn has a longer bottoming phase and a more gradual, less volatile recovery.

impact: 生猪价格的波动直接关系到中国宏观经济中的居民消费价格指数（CPI）走势及通胀预期。养殖利润的收缩短期内对农户和相关农业企业的经营现金流造成压力，但随着明年转折点的到来，行业将重回景气周期。在就业与民生方面，农业产业化龙头企业及饲料、养殖产业链的短期效益波动可能会影响相关岗位的薪酬水平和招聘规模。对于涉农专业及供应链管理等领域的青年毕业生而言，现代智慧农业和生猪产业的周期转型也孕育着数字化、精细化管理的新就业机遇。
graduate_impact: 传统农牧及下游饲料行业的盈利收缩，相关产业链企业的岗位扩张速度减缓。

dims.accumulation_node: 农业资本处于去库存阶段，周期性波动压低利润。
dims.spatial_layer: 产地与销地之间的价格传导受物流效率调节。
dims.state_market_shift: 农业农村部持续监测供给，市场供需调节主导价格。
dims.class_interest: 养殖资本与小农户面临资产缩水，终端消费者获得微弱生活成本减负。

cn_title: 生猪价格大幅下跌，行业转折点或将于明年到来
cn_summary: 根据农业农村部数据，10月份全国生猪平均价格环比下降，同比降幅明显，养殖场户面临头均亏损压力。产能充裕和供给充足是导致近期猪价持续走弱的主要原因。不过，随着季节性腌腊需求的到来以及元旦和春节前的备货期，猪肉消费正迎来季节性回升。加之此前能繁母猪产能的调减效应逐步显现，市场普遍预期行业供需关系有望在明年得到实质性改善。生猪产业正处于周期性筑底和调整的关键阶段。

title: 广东：1-10月份全省规模以上工业增加值同比增长6.1%
content_preview: 广东省统计局发布数据，1—10月份，全省规模以上工业增加值同比增长6.1%。分门类看，计算机、通信和其他电子设备制造业增加值增长11.4%，电气机械和器材制造业增长5.0%，电力、热力生产和供应业增长9.2%，汽车制造业增长11.9%，专业设备制造业、通用设备制造业分别增长14.5%、9.2%。 新动能产业发展壮大，先进制造业、高技术制造业增加值分别增长6.8%、11.4%，高于全部规模以上工业增速0.7个、5.3个百分点；占规模以上工业比重分别为57.2%、36.2%，比重同比提高1.6个、2.3个百分点。高技术产品增势良好，3D打印设备、工业机器人、集成电路产品产量分别增长74.0%、30.7%、28.5%；绿色产品增长较快，新能源汽车、锂离子电池、太阳能电池（光伏电池）产品产量分别增长52.0%、37.3%、11.3%。（界面）

title: 所罗门拟终止与华协议转向澳洲 北京指合作不应针对第三方
content_preview: 针对所罗门群岛拟终止与中国签署的安全协议，并与澳大利亚签署新条约的报道，中国外交部回应称，国际社会应共同帮助太平洋岛国实现可持续发展，坚持岛国自主、发展为先、开放包容，有关合作不应针对第三方。 中国和所罗门群岛于2022年签署的具有里程碑意义的安全合作协议，将于明年4月到期。澳大利亚媒体《悉尼先驱晨报》星期二（11月24日）引述所罗门群岛匿名消息人士的话报道称，所罗门群岛政府近日告知北京，不会续签这一安全协议。 报道还指出，澳大利亚和所罗门群岛预计将在星期三（25日）签署一项新的全面条约，巩固澳大利亚作为这个太平洋岛国最重要的安全伙伴的地位。 中国外交部发言人郭嘉昆星期二在例行记者会上回应这相关问题时说，中方始终秉持相互尊重、平等相待的原则发展同所罗门群岛关系。“中国同包括所罗门群岛在内的太平洋岛国合作不搞地缘博弈，不搞集团对抗，不针对第三方，也不受第三方影响”。 郭嘉昆说，国际社会应共同帮助太平洋岛国实现可持续发展，坚持岛国自主、发展为先、开放包容，“有关合作不应针对第三方”。 路透社报道指出，所罗门群岛位于澳大利亚东北方向1600公里处，近年来，因与中国关系日益密切，所罗门群岛的战略重要性备受关注。2022年所罗门群岛与中国签署的安全协议曾引发美国和南太平洋邻国的担忧。 今年5月，曾经批评中国的议会反对党领袖威尔（Matthew Wale）当选所罗门群岛新任总理。7月，澳大利亚和所罗门群岛于承诺深化双边关系，并共同批评中国在太平洋从核动力潜艇发射弹道导弹的试验。

title: 疫苗处方全面推行，哪些机构能开、怎么开？最新解读
content_preview: 国家疾控局今天（11月23日）举行新闻发布会，主题是“科学防病健康自塑 共绘‘十五五’健康蓝图”。国家疾控局等部门近日出台了全面推行疫苗处方的文件，中国疾病预防控制中心免疫规划中心主任医师余文周介绍，近年来，有些省份和地区探索由医师为诊疗对象开具疫苗处方，群众在就诊过程中就能获得专业的疫苗接种指导。这一项服务举措，不仅提升了公众的接种意识和防病素养，也提高了预防接种服务的便利性。 首先，明确了疫苗处方定位。《指导意见》明确，疫苗处方是在基层医疗卫生机构、二级及以上医疗机构、妇幼保健机构等，由有资质的医师在日常诊疗服务过程中，为符合条件的诊疗对象推荐适合其接种的疫苗。所以，疫苗处方是医师提出的初步建议。诊疗对象持处方到接种门诊后，接种人员还要进行接种前评估，把好最后一道关口，最终判定是否适合接种处方推荐的疫苗。 其次，明确了资质条件。疫苗处方不是随意开具的，文件明确了资质条件等门槛，注册执业的临床医师、中医医师、公共卫生医师，以及偏远地区的执业助理医师、乡村医生，经过县级以上疾控、卫生健康、中医药部门组织的规范化培训、考核后，具备相应能力才可以开具疫苗处方。开具处方的医师，要结合季节性疾病流行趋势，诊疗对象健康状况、疫苗接种史、过敏史和暴露风险等因素，综合判断诊疗对象是否可以接种疫苗。文件明确了对成人、儿童青少年重点推荐的疫苗，还要求各地开展疫苗处方实施情况的效果评价。有培训、有考核、有评估，才能守住安全底线。（央视新闻）

title: 澳大利亚经济衰退风险上升
content_preview: 澳大利亚大型金融服务集团麦格理24日警告，受通胀高企、利率上升和失业率攀升等多重因素影响，澳大利亚经济陷入衰退的概率可能已接近50%。 麦格理集团首席经济学家兼宏观策略主管里克·德弗雷尔表示，越来越多证据表明，澳大利亚经济增长势头正在减弱，商业信心低迷预示着今年第四季度经济存在萎缩风险。 此前，汇丰银行澳大利亚和新西兰首席经济学家保罗·布洛克瑟姆曾预测，澳大利亚经济在未来几个季度将陷入停滞，且有50%的可能性陷入衰退。（新华社）

title: 【软银拟出售旗下科技媒体 ITmedia 控股权，集中资源押注 AI】据日本经济新闻报道，软银公司正考虑出售其在线媒体子
content_preview: 【软银拟出售旗下科技媒体 ITmedia 控股权，集中资源押注 AI】据日本经济新闻报道，软银公司正考虑出售其在线媒体子公司 ITmedia 的控股权，以将经营资源集中于人工智能（AI）业务。截至 2026 年 9 月底，软银公司通过其全资子公司 SB Media Holdings 持有 ITmedia 52.98% 的股份。 软银已委任瑞穗证券作为财务顾问，启动出售的前期准备工作。ITmedia 目前在东京证券交易所 Prime 市场上市，截至 2026 年 11 月 24 日，其总市值约为 253 亿日元。若出售交易最终达成，ITmedia 可能会被私有化退市，从而消除日本资本市场长期关注的“母子公司同时上市”结构。软银方面对该报道未予置评。

title: 【莱茵生物：拟5000万元-1亿元回购公司股份】莱茵生物11月24日公告，公司拟使用自有资金和/或自筹资金以集中竞价交易
content_preview: 【莱茵生物：拟5000万元-1亿元回购公司股份】莱茵生物11月24日公告，公司拟使用自有资金和/或自筹资金以集中竞价交易方式回购公司已发行的人民币普通股(A股)股票，用于实施股权激励或员工持股计划。本次回购资金总额不低于5000万元(含)，不超过1亿元(含)，回购价格上限为9.56元/股。按回购金额上限、回购价格上限测算，预计可回购股份约10460251股，约占公司目前已发行总股本的1.41%；按下限测算预计约523.01万股，约占0.71%。回购实施期限为自董事会审议通过回购方案之日起12个月内。

title: 湖北宜化：拟参与投资建设磷系新能源材料产业园项目
content_preview: 【湖北宜化：拟参与投资建设磷系新能源材料产业园项目】财联社11月24日电，湖北宜化(000422.SZ)公告称，公司控股股东宜化集团与宜昌市政府、湖北联投集团签订合作协议，拟由公司控股子公司参与投资建设磷系新能源材料产业园项目。该项目将建设磷矿开采、选矿、磷酸、精制磷酸、磷酸铁、磷酸铁锂和黑粉回收全链条一体化项目，选址位于宜昌高新区白洋工业园，拟分两期建设。公司表示，本次投资有利于加快完善磷系新能源材料产业布局，对公司2026年度经营业绩暂不构成重大影响。项目尚存在审批、市场变化等不确定性风险。

title: 355 Ukrainian drones flew toward Moscow overnight, prompting flight restrictions at two airports
content_preview: Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin said 355 Ukrainian drones flew toward the capital overnight on November 24. Air defense forces shot down most of the drones “at distant approaches” and destroyed 63 more as they approached Moscow, he said on his Telegram channel. Moscow’s Vnukovo and Sheremetyevo airports received and dispatched flights only with special clearance for several hours, Rosaviatsia reported. Restrictions were also imposed at Kaluga’s Grabtsevo airport on the evening of November 23 because of the risk of a drone attack. Kaluga Governor Vyacheslav Shapsha said air defense forces destroyed 60 drones over the region that evening and night. There were no casualties or damage, he said. Russia’s Defense Ministry said Russian air defense forces shot down 699 Ukrainian drones overnight over Russian territory and occupied Crimea, including over the Bryansk, Belgorod, Kaluga, Moscow, Oryol, and Smolensk regions. cn_title: 夜间355架乌克兰无人机飞向莫斯科，两座机场实施航班限制
cn_summary: 莫斯科市长谢尔盖·索比亚宁于11月24日在其Telegram频道宣布，当夜共有355架乌克兰无人机向莫斯科方向飞来。他表示，防空部队在“远距离接近时”拦截并击落了绝大多数无人机，并在接近莫斯科时摧毁了另外63架。俄罗斯联邦航空运输局报告称，受此影响，莫斯科伏努科沃机场和谢列梅捷沃机场仅在获得特殊许可的情况下维持了数小时的航班起降。此外，卡卢加州的格拉布采沃机场也于11月23日晚间实施了相关限制措施。

title: Estonia’s interior minister suggests petitioning Putin to end war in Ukraine after Narva resident launches petition to keep border with Russia open for family visits
content_preview: Ksenia Agar, a Narva resident, has launched a petition asking Estonia to keep its border with Russia open for family visits. The petition was posted on Estonia’s platform for citizen initiatives on November 19. As of publication, more than 2,000 people had signed it. Agar posted a link to the petition in the Facebook group “Russian-Speaking Estonia.” Estonian Interior Minister Igor Taro commented on the post: Where can Russian-speaking residents sign a petition calling on Putin to end the war and stop hostile actions against European countries so sanctions can be lifted and people can travel the way they did before 2022? When are you finally going to rally outside the Russian Embassy to make those same demands? Starting December 1, Estonia is closing all land crossings on its border with Russia for at least six months. The closure was prompted by an attempt to set fire to the premises of defense company Threod Systems. Estonian authorities accused Russian intelligence of orchestrating the attempted sabotage. Not everyone agrees with the government’s decision. President Ülle Madise urged officials to weigh the consequences and not let emotions drive them to close the border. Narva Mayor Jaan Toots demanded “humanitarian corridors” for emergency trips to Russia. Estonia and Russia Estonia is closing its border with Russia after an alleged sabotage attempt — and preparing to move government services to the cloud in case of invasion Anonymous social media accounts are calling for the secession of an Estonian county on Russia’s border. Tallinn says it’s Moscow’s doing. title: South Korea scrambles fighter jets over Russian military aircraft, issues evacuation alert on island
content_preview: South Korea’s Joint Chiefs of Staff said several Russian military planes briefly entered the country’s air defense identification zone over the Sea of Japan on the morning of November 24. The planes approached Ulleungdo Island but did not violate South Korean airspace, the Joint Chiefs of Staff said. South Korea scrambled fighter jets in response, and the Russian planes left the air defense identification zone. The Internal Affairs Ministry sent residents of Ulleungdo Island a warning urging them to evacuate to underground shelters, saying a plane believed to be North Korean had violated South Korean airspace. Authorities in South Korea’s North Gyeongsang Province later sent residents of the island a message canceling the alert, saying the planes in question were Russian. South Korea’s Defense Ministry said at a briefing that it plans to summon a representative of the Russian embassy in Seoul to lodge an official protest. An air defense identification zone is not a country’s sovereign airspace. It is established unilaterally so that aircraft identify themselves for safety as they approach a country’s borders. AFP notes that military aircraft usually notify the relevant country before entering its air defense identification zone, although such notification is not legally required. cn_title: 韩国就俄罗斯军机抵近紧急出动战机，并向某岛屿发布疏散警报
cn_summary: 韩国联合参谋本部表示，11月24日上午，数架俄罗斯军机短暂进入了韩国位于日本海的防空识别区。这些军机一度逼近郁陵岛，但并未侵犯韩国领空。作为回应，韩国军方紧急出动了战机进行拦截和伴飞，随后俄军机驶离防空识别区。韩国行政安全部向郁陵岛居民发送了紧急疏散预警警报，引发了当地居民的短暂紧张。区域地缘政治紧张局势再次因海空对峙而升温。

cn_summary: 欧洲央行管理委员会委员西姆库斯警告称，如果通胀压力持续存在，欧洲央行在2027年将需要进一步收紧货币政策。这表明央行对于长期通胀风险保持高度警惕，且不排除在未来数年内继续加息的可能。长期的政策紧缩预期旨在向市场传递坚决打击通胀的信 号。决策层愿意为实现价格稳定付出更持久的政策代价。这一中长期展望显示出欧洲货币政策正常化的道路依然漫长。

title: 【浙江省政府党组第109次会议暨省政府第132次常务会议召开 刘捷主持】会议指出，1—10月，全省经济运行延续稳中有进、
content_preview: 【浙江省政府党组第109次会议暨省政府第132次常务会议召开 刘捷主持】会议指出，1—10月，全省经济运行延续稳中有进、向新向好态势。要进一步增强冲刺四季度、打好收官战的信心决心，锚定年度目标冲刺攻坚，持续推进创新浙江建设，加快人工智能产业链发展，抓好科技创新主体培育。继续发挥工业“压舱石”作用，强化项目全生命周期管理，推动项目达产达效，解决好企业急难愁盼。着力推进服务业扩能提质，聚焦56条细分赛道高质量创新发展，继续抓权重行业、抓主体、抓平台、抓项目、抓品牌；落实好全国老龄工作会议精神，稳步提高养老保障和服务水平，并做好居民服务业优质供给，解决“一老一小”后顾之忧。认真推进“六张网”建设，加大产业项目招商引资和项目储备力度，支持企业技改投资，进一步做好稳投资、促招商工作。持续打好“稳拓调优”组合拳，全力推动外经贸高质量发展。积极谋划推进岁末年初促消费活动，迭代完善一揽子促消费政策，大力发展服务消费、数字消费，更好激发消费活力。有序推进“双碳”工作，紧扣“三优化一提升”重点任务，扎实做好各项工作推进落地。抓实抓细安全生产隐患排查整治，兜牢民生保障底线，确保社会大局和谐稳定。深入基层、深入企业开展调查研究，认真谋划明年工作思路及“8+4”经济政策体系、“千项万亿”重大项目等重点任务，为明年“开好局、起好步”打下坚实基础。（浙江发布）

content_preview: 欧洲央行管委Simkus：若通胀持续，2027年需要进一步收紧政策。 工会可能会要求加薪以弥补通胀影响。 随着通胀范围扩大，温和的限制性立场是审慎之举。 看不到过度收紧的风险。 近期欧元疲软是另一个通胀因素。 欧洲央行应提前采取行动，宜早不宜迟。
content: 欧洲央行管委Simkus：若通胀持续，2027年需要进一步收紧政策。 工会可能会要求加薪以弥补通胀影响。 随着通胀范围扩大，温和的限制性立场是审慎之举。 看不到过度收紧的风险。 近期欧元疲软是另一个通胀因素。 欧洲央行应提前采取行动，宜早不宜迟。

title: Germany sent tanks to Lithuania by rail instead of driving them through Poland ‘to avoid provoking Putin,’ Bild reports
content_preview: Germany sent military equipment by rail to the “Grand Eagle 26” exercises in Lithuania instead of driving the vehicles through Poland, the German tabloid Bild reported , citing sources. According to those sources, Germany’s armed forces chose rail transport “to avoid provoking Putin.” “Pictures of German tanks rolling toward the Baltics near the border with Belarus would have been a propaganda gift for Putin,” the sources suggested. Germany’s Defense Ministry said that “changing the mode of transport is not unusual and must be practiced, since it must also be possible in the event of a real threat.” The “Grand Eagle 26” exercises run from November 6 to December 3. Germany plans to station an armored brigade in Lithuania by the end of 2027, with 5,000 German troops and 2,000 vehicles, including dozens of tanks. After Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022, Germany allocated hundreds of billions of euros to defense, sharply increasing military spending. Russia, NATO, and the security of the Baltic states Lithuania’s foreign minister says NATO could ‘level’ Russia’s military bases in Kaliningrad. Moscow threatens nuclear retaliation. Analysts outline possible scenario for Russia-NATO war in 2030: Putin dies and Russia invades Estonia Western officials fear Putin is preparing to escalate beyond Ukraine. title: More than 700,000 Russian troops died in the war in Ukraine by late September 2026, Meduza and Mediazona estimate
content_preview: Part of a chart based on data from the Register of Inheritance Cases On November 1, news broke that hackers from the Belarusian Cyber Partisans and Silent Crow had breached the website of Rosstat, Russia’s federal statistics agency, and obtained data on Russian military losses in the war through fall 2026. The hackers used that data to produce their own estimate of how many Russians had been killed on the front lines. They also shared the database with reporters, including those at Meduza and Mediazona, which have been tracking Russia’s military death toll together for several years. We examined the hacked database and concluded that it was very likely authentic. We then compared its records with other sources and ran a new analysis. Our earlier studies relied mainly on data from the Register of Inheritance Cases. The Rosstat database makes the new estimate more reliable. Another important change: The new estimate counts both registered deaths and missing service members, many of whom will likely be confirmed dead. Based on registered deaths alone, we estimate that 490,000 Russian service members had been killed by fall 2026. Including missing service members brings the estimate to more than 700,000. Here’s how Meduza and Mediazona arrived at these grim estimates. Foreword What to know about our new study By the end of September 2026, at least 490,000 Russian service members had been killed in the war with Ukraine. These are people whose deaths have already been registered and appear in the leaked Rosstat documents. Meduza and Mediazona jointly checked the data obtained by the hackers and found it to be genuine. It would simply be impossible to fake this many records that match information from other sources. The leak is valuable because it contains a large amount of previously unavailable data. title: 【金巴斯集团计划将主要上市地迁至纽约 加剧伦敦上市公司外流局面】英国餐饮公司金巴斯集团计划将主要上市地由伦敦迁至纽约，令
content_preview: 【金巴斯集团计划将主要上市地迁至纽约 加剧伦敦上市公司外流局面】英国餐饮公司金巴斯集团计划将主要上市地由伦敦迁至纽约，令英国股市面临的不利局面进一步加剧。这家总部位于英格兰彻特西的公司周二公布全年业绩时表示，迁移将于2028年完成，这证实了上周末的报道。金巴斯将保留伦敦作为第二上市地，并将就这项决定征询股东意见。对金巴斯而言，此举使公司更贴近其最重要的市场。目前，北美贡献了公司75%的基本利润。

title: 打败字节猫箱，Tipsy率先盈利，AI陪伴产品杀疯了
content_preview: 当整个市场都在质疑“AI应用为大模型打工”时，AI陪伴产品们给了行业带来了希望。 一款名为Tipsy Chat的AI陪伴产品在快速崛起，最疯狂的时候，App单月下载环比增加991.55%。这款由字节跳动、阿里前员工于2024年创业，做出来的产品，因为把AI变成了用户的虚拟男友、恋人，甚至是和用户共同推进剧情的故事搭档而在北美和欧洲爆火。 多方获悉，Tipsy已经实现盈利，这意味着中国AI应用出现了首款盈利产品。据移动应用数据分析公司Sensor Tower的报告，Tipsy Chat在2026年8月的月度经常性收入（MRR）达到1700万美元，日活跃用户却不足50万。对比之下，Kimi在今年8月的ARR超过10亿美元，却仍在亏损。（Tech星球）

title: 【视频】神舟二十四号瞄准25日8时18分发射 外籍航天员任务公布
content_preview: 中国神舟二十四号载人飞船瞄准星期三（11月25日）早上8时18分发射。 中国载人航天工程办公室星期二（11月24日）上午在酒泉卫星发射中心召开新闻发布会宣布，神舟二十四号船箭飞行产品质量受控，航天员乘组状态良好，空间站组合体状态正常，具备执行发射任务条件，将于星期三在酒泉卫星发射中心由长征二号F遥二十四运载火箭发射升空。 航天员乘组由汤洪波（指令长）、武毅以及巴基斯坦航天员穆罕默德·齐尚·阿里（载荷专家）组成。 其中，巴基斯坦航天员穆罕默德·齐尚·阿里（Muhammad Zeeshan Ali）将成为首位到访中国“天宫”空间站的外籍航天员，执行短期任务后将随神舟二十三号乘组返回地球。航天员汤洪波执行过神舟十二号、神舟十七号载人飞行任务。航天员武毅来自于中国第三批航天员，是首次执行飞行任务。 据央视新闻，中国载人航天工程办公室发言人在发布会上介绍，根据任务安排，巴基斯坦航天员将以载荷专家身份执行短期飞行任务。在轨期间，除参与乘组日常工作外，主要承担中巴合作空间科学实验任务，重点完成实验样品及实验单元的安装，并按计划开展在轨实验。 发言人表示，为确保联合飞行任务顺利实施，重点强化了三方面的工作。一是专业技能训练。针对短期飞行任务特点，系统开展载人飞船、空间站知识和专业操作训练，突出做好科学实验操作和应急处置能力训练。二是乘组协同训练。针对岗位分工和协同配合需要，重点围绕操作配合、流程衔接和故障处置等开展联合训练，确保工作协同高效。 三是语言技能培训。针对中文操作指令和标识，重点强化任务相关口令和专业词汇学习，确保指令执行准确。 短期飞行任务结束后，巴基斯坦航天员会与航天员张志远、黎家盈共同搭乘神舟二十三号载人飞船返回。航天员张志远将担任返回任务指令长。 发言人也介绍，神舟二十四号载人飞船入轨后，将优先采用3.5小时自主快速交会对接策略，对接于天和核心舱前向端口，形成三船三舱组合体。 神舟二十三号乘组中的航天员朱杨柱，将继续在轨驻留，完成一年期在轨驻留试验。 （视频来源：CCTV+）

title: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz says it was a mistake to leave Ukraine out of NATO in 2008
content_preview: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz said Ukraine should have been admitted to NATO in 2008. He made the remarks at a joint press conference with NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte, Die Zeit reported . Merz said it was a mistake not to back the U.S. proposal on Ukraine’s NATO membership at the alliance’s summit in Bucharest that year. Had Ukraine joined the alliance then, he said, the current war “probably would have been prevented.” Merz also called French President Emmanuel Macron’s proposal to reopen debate on Ukraine’s NATO membership a logical step. The chancellor said the proposal was in line with the security guarantees Ukraine needs, which “we intend to give it even after this war ends.” He said he meant security guarantees “similar to the provisions of Article 5 ” of the North Atlantic Treaty. In Merz’s view, these guarantees come “as close as possible” to full NATO membership. During a visit to Kyiv in April 2008, then-U.S. President George W. Bush said he would press NATO to offer Georgia and Ukraine a Membership Action Plan at the alliance’s summit in Bucharest. He said , “Helping Ukraine move toward NATO membership is in the interest of every member in the Alliance and will help advance security and freedom in this region and around the world.” The summit ended, however, without Ukraine and Georgia receiving the action plan they had expected. That year, Vladimir Putin said NATO should consider Russia’s position on whether Ukraine should join. At the time, German Chancellor Angela Merkel opposed Ukraine joining NATO. She said it was still too soon for Ukraine and Georgia to join. In 2022, Merkel said she still believed her 2008 decision not to support fast-tracking Ukraine’s NATO membership had been the right one. She also said Putin would have blocked Ukraine from joining NATO and would have seen its admission as “a declaration of war.” At Meduza, we are committed to transparency about our use of artificial intelligence in the newsroom. title: 【猪价大降了，明年或迎猪价拐点】金十期货11月24日讯，据农业农村部监测，10月份以来，全国生猪价格走低，养殖处于亏损区
content_preview: 【猪价大降了，明年或迎猪价拐点】金十期货11月24日讯，据农业农村部监测，10月份以来，全国生猪价格走低，养殖处于亏损区间。10月份全国生猪价格为每公斤10.77元，环比下降5.7%，同比下降14.3%，10月份全国自繁自养养殖户出栏一头生猪平均亏损200元左右。生猪价格下降重要原因是供应充裕、产能较高，而加快去产能既可以减少亏损，也利于生猪整体供需形势的改善。专家表示，从消费端看，腌腊、灌肠等需求启动，叠加元旦、春节备货需求，猪肉消费进入传统旺季。从生产端看，前期能繁母猪产能调减效果将逐渐显现，出栏同比增幅将收窄，市场供大于求状况有所缓解。中国农业科学院北京畜牧兽医研究所研究员朱增勇表示，随着今年二季度以来能繁母猪集中去化效果逐渐释放，2027年二季度前后供需关系将会明显改善，猪价有望稳步、温和回升。以往猪周期是快速去产能、价格急涨急跌，本轮周期则是底部磨底时间更长，上涨更平缓，波动幅度变小。希望养殖场户合理安排出栏节奏，顺时顺势出栏。

title: Russia to spend 47 billion rubles on ferries to Kaliningrad amid fears of transport blockade
content_preview: Russian authorities will build two railway ferries to supply the Kaliningrad region in case of a transport blockade, Prime Minister Mikhail Mishustin said. He said the ferries will be built at a domestic shipyard to a Russian design and will operate between the ports of Ust-Luga, in the Leningrad region, and Baltiysk, in the Kaliningrad region. Railway ferry, West Germany, 1981 A government order Mishustin signed in early November set the project’s cost at 47 billion rubles, though he did not rule out the budget reaching 50 billion. The government expects the new ferries to boost shipping volumes and lower delivery costs for businesses, with the project due for completion by 2030. In late September, Russia threatened to use nuclear weapons if NATO attempted to blockade the Kaliningrad region. The Russian embassy in Ireland published the statement. Reuters reported that Russian authorities had sent the alliance a similar warning. In October, NATO’s Supreme Allied Commander Europe, Alexus Grynkewich, presented a “quick victory” strategy for a potential Russian attack. The Wall Street Journal reported that the strategy includes, among other things, missile strikes on Russian command posts and air defense systems in the Kaliningrad region, the St. Petersburg area, and Belarus. title: Russian strikes kill two in Ukraine’s Zaporizhzhia, injure dozens
content_preview: Russian forces struck Zaporizhzhia overnight on November 24, killing two people, said Mykhailo Semikin, the acting head of the regional military administration. More than 40 people were injured, according to the latest data. Four of them are children, Semikin said, the youngest just a few months old. The strikes destroyed a private home, partially destroyed a five-story apartment building and damaged other multistory and private homes, as well as transportation infrastructure, according to the region’s governor. cn_title: 俄军空袭乌克兰扎波罗热致2人死亡、数十人受伤
cn_summary: 据扎波罗热地区军事管理部门代理负责人米哈伊尔·谢米金称，俄军于11月24日夜间对扎波罗热实施了猛烈空袭，目前已造成2人死亡。最新数据显示，袭击造成40多人受伤，其中包括4名儿童，最小的仅几个月大。空袭摧毁了一处私人住宅，并部分损毁了一栋五层公寓楼以及其他多层住宅和交通基础设施。救援和善后工作正在紧张进行中。
impact: 地缘政治冲突的持续升级进一步增加了全球宏观经济的不确定性，对国际能源、粮食价格以及全球供应链构成了潜在扰动。中国作为全球贸易的重要一环，需防范外部输入性通胀和地缘政治风险带来的负面溢出效应。由于外部环境复杂多变，部分外向型企业可能面临订单波动，这在一定程度上会对国内部分行业的出口及相关青年就业岗位的稳定性产生影响。

title: Blasts and shrapnel account for 92% of recorded Russian military deaths in Ukraine, iStories reports. Gunshot wounds account for less than 2%.
content_preview: Explosions and shrapnel accounted for 92% of recorded Russian military deaths in the war against Ukraine. The investigative outlet iStories highlighted the figure after reviewing a database of Russian front-line military losses compiled by Rosstat, Russia’s federal statistics agency, and shared by hackers. Meduza and other news outlets reviewed the same data at the same time. Gunfire accounted for only 1.3% of deaths. Other, even less common causes included coronary heart disease (about 2,000 deaths), suicide (about 1,300), and pneumonia (about 700). Based on their analysis of the database, Meduza and Mediazona calculated that at least 720,000 Russian service members had died in the war against Ukraine by fall 2026. Russian military losses in Ukraine More than 700,000 Russian troops died in the war in Ukraine by late September 2026, Meduza and Mediazona estimate Western analysts say Russia is on track to losing 50,000 soldiers a month. A Meduza investigation suggests those estimates are based on manipulated data. Russia’s military losses in Ukraine surpass any major power since WWII. Yet re-deployed wounded obscure the true toll. title: 6G试点正式启动！北京等8省市获批开展
content_preview: 工业和信息化部今天在上海正式启动6G创新发展部省协同试点，北京、河北、上海、江苏、浙江、安徽、湖北、广东8个省市获批开展6G试点工作。 6G部省协同试点的重点任务是：在国家层面体系布局基础上，因地制宜，围绕新型终端、关键芯片器件、仪器仪表、卫星互联网等6G关联产业，面向沉浸式通信、工业制造、低空经济、海洋经济等6G潜在应用场景加强攻关，形成全国6G“一盘棋”发展格局。 记者从6G推进组了解到，按照国际标准化组织制定的时间表，首版6G国际标准预计2029年上半年发布，2027年上半年将完成6G标准基础研究工作，目前6G技术标准研究已经进入冲刺阶段。（央视）

title: 中远海控：推进人工智能技术全业务场景落地应用
content_preview: 中远海控高管在2026年第三季度业绩说明会上介绍，中远海控积极推进人工智能技术在全业务场景的落地应用。目前，智能询价Agent、智能客服已投入日常使用，智能供应链管家、大订单客户端正持续迭代优化，此外公司现已搭建起海陆铁路多式联运数字化管理体系，运营效率和客户体验得到显著提升。另外，根据规划，公司年度内分配的现金分红总额应占公司当年度实现的归属于上市公司股东净利润的30%—50%。据统计，自2021年起至今，在满足现金分红条件的前提下，公司共实施现金分红10次，现金红利合计约人民币7.99元/股，累计派发现金红利总额超过1268亿元。（证券时报）

title: 梁文锋身家550亿美元 成为全世界最富有的AI模型创造者
content_preview: 中国人工智能（AI）初创企业深度求索（DeepSeek）完成新一轮融资后，创始人梁文锋的身家攀升至550亿美元（710亿新元），成为世界最富有的AI模型创造者。 注册申报文件显示，梁文锋在深度求索的持股率于6月从81.65%降至67.4%。 彭博社星期一（11月23日）引述知情人士，以及彭博亿万富翁指数根据深度求索近期约1000亿人民币（193亿新元）融资额计算得出，深度求索的隐含估值（Implied valuation）为860亿美元。 上述指数显示，梁文锋的净资产较今年较早时翻了三倍多。 41岁梁文锋身家的飙涨，让他明显较美国AI巨企创始人更富裕。梁文锋目前的财富要比OpenAI联合创始人布罗克曼（Greg Brockman）超出两倍多。截至上周五（11月20日），布罗克曼的身家为255亿美元。Anthropic上周上市后，首席执行官阿莫代伊（Dario Amodei）身家为220亿美元。 上述显著差距，主要因为梁文锋持有深度求索超过三分之二股权，布罗克曼和阿莫代伊在各自公司持有较少股权。

cn_title: 高市早苗在与国际刑事法院院长会晤中承诺提前支付财政支持
cn_summary: 日本经济安全保障担当大臣高市早苗在与国际刑事法院（ICC）院长会晤时表示，日本将提前支付对该法院的财政捐款。这是自今年1月以来双方的首次面对面会谈。此举发生在美国对ICC实施制裁的背景下，显示了日本在国际司法机构运作上的立场。日本政府通过此举重申了对国际法治的支持。该决定旨在确保法院在面临外部压力时仍能维持正常运作。
impact: 对中国而言，此举反映了国际地缘政治中司法独立与大国博弈的复杂性。对中国宏观经济影响有限，但提醒中国企业在参与国际业务时需关注国际法律环境的变化。对就业市场及青年毕业生而言，这增加了国际法、国际关系及合规法律人才的需求，为相关专业毕业生提供了更多跨国机构或智库的就业机会。

title: Western intelligence services say Russia could put satellite with nuclear warhead into orbit in coming months
content_preview: Russia may put a satellite carrying a nuclear explosive device into orbit, Western intelligence services and military officials believe, including the Bundeswehr (Germany’s armed forces) and Germany’s Federal Intelligence Service. Representatives of several NATO countries recently exchanged information on the matter, the German outlets WDR, NDR, and Süddeutsche Zeitung reported. The satellite, called “Sputnik-S,” has been kept ready for launch near Moscow for several years. Intelligence agencies warned in early November 2026 that the satellite, which carries a nuclear warhead, could be launched within the next 60 days. The Bundeswehr’s Space Command estimates “Sputnik-S” could reach orbit as early as December. Bundeswehr experts briefed German government officials, including Defense Minister Boris Pistorius, on “Sputnik-S,” German journalists reported. The Russian embassy, responding to a request from the outlets, said Russia’s space research is conducted “in accordance with international obligations” and “exclusively for peaceful purposes.” Russian diplomats rejected “all unfounded accusations regarding Russia’s space activities,” calling them “part of a propaganda campaign.” The Kremlin said it had not seen the German media reports that Russia is preparing to put a satellite with a nuclear warhead into orbit. “But there is so much ‘allegedly possible’ and ‘according to who knows whom’ in there that it’s hardly worth taking seriously,” Russian presidential press secretary Dmitry Peskov added. title: 全球科技股强势反弹 台股领涨A股港股掉队
content_preview: 美国晶片巨头英伟达创办人黄仁勋复职，提振市场对人工智能（AI）产业的投资信心，亚太股市星期二（11月24日）普遍大涨，台湾股市领涨，中国大陆股市涨幅有限，港股高开低走。 英伟达星期一（11月23日）宣布恢复黄仁勋的总裁、首席执行官和董事职务，带动公司股价飙涨31.5%。美国纳斯达克指数当天大涨6.5%，标普500指数上涨4.7%，结束连续七个交易日的跌势。 受隔夜美股大涨带动，韩国综合指数星期二盘中涨逾6%，三星电子和SK海力士股价大幅攀升。日本日经225指数上涨3.9%。 台湾股市领涨亚太市场，加权指数收盘飙涨8.99%至40122.35点，单日上涨3310.46点，创历史最大单日上涨点数纪录。台湾上市和上柜股票近700只涨停，权重股台积电大涨9.85%。 相比之下，中国大陆股市冲高回落。沪指收涨0.27%，深成指跌0.29%，创业板指数跌0.05%。 香港股市表现更为疲弱，恒生指数午间收跌0.39%，恒生科技指数由开盘上涨2.05%转为下跌0.99%，互联网科技股普遍走低。 中国媒体人，《环球时报》前总编辑胡锡进在A股收盘后发微博称“今天绝大多数 A股股民都失望了，上午补仓的人尤其唏嘘”。 他说，“在全球大涨环境下，A股依然高开低走、勉强保住红盘，这究竟是什么原因？又让股民的信心何以安放？把A股认真搞好吧，不要让它成为一个溃疡处，它应该是一个突破口和动力源”。

title: On day of Putin’s visit, Tajikistan notifies UN of withdrawal from International Criminal Court
content_preview: Tajikistan has officially notified the United Nations that it is withdrawing from the Rome Statute and leaving the International Criminal Court, the Russian state news agency TASS reported. Tajikistan sent the notification to U.N. Secretary-General António Guterres on November 20. Under the Rome Statute, its withdrawal will take effect in exactly one year. Russian President Vladimir Putin visited Tajikistan on November 20. The International Criminal Court issued an arrest warrant for Putin in 2023 on suspicion of unlawfully deporting Ukrainian children. Tajikistan’s government did not arrest him despite its obligations under the ICC, just as it had not during his 2025 visit. The EU criticized Dushanbe for failing to do so. In 2024, Putin flew to Mongolia, but authorities there — also an ICC member — likewise did not arrest him. Hungary, another ICC member, refused in 2025 to arrest Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, against whom the court had issued a warrant on suspicion of war crimes and crimes against humanity in the Gaza Strip. More than 120 countries worldwide have ratified the Rome Statute, which governs the ICC. However, major countries including the United States, China, Russia, India, and Turkey are not members of the court. title: Ukrainian drones strike two Russian oil refineries and pumping station in overnight attacks
content_preview: Update. Ukrainian monitoring channels reported an attack on the Lukoil-Permnefteorgsintez refinery in Perm Krai. Authorities in Perm Krai said Ukrainian drones struck an unnamed “industrial facility,” sparking a fire that killed one person and injured two others. Ukrainian forces struck oil infrastructure facilities in Almetyevsk, Tatarstan, and Novoshakhtinsk, Rostov region, overnight on November 23. In Almetyevsk, Ukrainian forces struck the Kaleykino oil pumping station again. The independent Telegram channel Astra and the Ukrainian monitoring project Exilenova+ published footage of the fire at the station. The Russian state news agency TASS reported, citing the press service of the head of Tatarstan, that oil storage tanks had been hit in the republic. “As a result of the prolonged raid, several facilities sustained damage. There are no deaths or injuries,” the statement said. In the Rostov region, Ukrainian drones struck the Novoshakhtinsk oil products plant. Witnesses captured footage showing black smoke rising over the city. The Kaleykino oil pumping station is one of the key nodes in Russia’s pipeline network. It belongs to Transneft–Prikamye, a joint-stock company. Ukrainian drones last attacked it on November 19. The Novoshakhtinsk oil products plant is the only refinery in the Rostov region and one of the largest fuel suppliers in southern Russia. It has repeatedly been a target of Ukrainian strikes. In late September, authorities in the Rostov region reported that the refinery had halted operations after another attack. Lukoil-Permnefteorgsintez is one of the largest oil refineries in Russia. title: FEDS Paper: The Welfare Effects of Bank Liquidity and Capital Requirements(Revised)
content_preview: Skander J. Van den Heuvel and Sergio Villalvazo The stringency of bank liquidity and capital requirements should depend on their social costs and benefits. Equilibrium asset returns yield two simple formulas that express the welfare cost of each requirement as a function of observable variables only. Based on U.S. data, the welfare cost of a 10% liquidity requirement is equivalent to a permanent loss in consumption of about 0.02%, a modest impact. Even using conservative measurements, the cost of a similarly sized increase in the capital requirement is roughly tenfold. Still, optimal policy relies on both requirements to mitigate moral hazard from deposit insurance and is close to Basel III levels.

title: European Commission proposes denying visas to Russians who fought in war against Ukraine
content_preview: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen presented a draft of the 22nd package of sanctions against Russia. The new measures are designed to increase pressure on Moscow in three areas, she said: Russian banks and cryptocurrency platforms, tighter visa rules, and stronger enforcement of already-imposed sanctions. The 22nd sanctions package includes the following measures: a ban on displaying official Russian symbols at sporting events, barring Russian athletes from competing under the Russian flag in the EU; a ban on entry into the European Union for former combatants, though it remains unclear whether this applies only to those who fought in Russia’s war with Ukraine or also to participants in other conflicts; restrictions on 60 Russian banks, which will be disconnected from the SWIFT system, along with restrictions on cryptocurrency and payment services; an expanded ban on energy services, including electricity, that will prohibit European companies from cooperating with Russia in that sector; more than 70 additional vessels from Russia’s shadow fleet added to the sanctions list; Russian citizens barred from holding leadership positions in European sports federations; citizens of European countries barred from participating in the management of Russian companies. “We will continue to propose new sanctions until Russia shows genuine intent for a lasting peace in Ukraine,” von der Leyen said. title: 金饰已爆单缺货 金饰爆款订单排到1个月后
content_preview: 近期国际金价波动明显，购金需求持续释放，记者在河南郑州的黄金珠宝核心商圈走访了解到，年末黄金市场迎来消费高峰。 目前市场上，古法手镯、简约素圈项链、平安扣吊坠、小金豆等轻量化百搭款式最受消费者青睐；同时，适合儿童佩戴的长命锁、转运珠等小克重金饰销量也持续走高。 针对本轮黄金消费热，业内人士分析，黄金短期大幅降价释放了市场积压的消费需求。年末婚嫁、年终自我犒劳等消费场景集中爆发，叠加商家密集促销，共同推动黄金饰品市场持续升温。 除了各大黄金卖场销售火热外，不少黄金首饰加工工作室依靠个性化定制满足多元化需求，订单量也大幅上升，一些爆款首饰订单排期甚至排到一个月之后。市场消费火热，一度让上游供应、加工端货品出现缺货情况。某黄金珠宝展厅负责人表示：“销售提升了至少40%到50%，对金价下跌预估不足，造成很多货品短缺，很多款式短时间内补不过来。” （央视财经）

title: Russia charges Moscow military gear retailer with ‘financing extremist activity’ over alleged donations to Navalny’s Anti-Corruption Foundation
content_preview: Anton Linkvist, the founder and CEO of the military gear store chain Vtoroi Front (Second Front), was taken into custody in Moscow in connection with donations to the Anti-Corruption Foundation. Ostorozhno Novosti, which first reported the arrest, said Linkvist’s name appeared in leaked information about donations to the foundation. According to the outlet, he was detained on November 19 and placed in pretrial detention the next day. TASS later confirmed the arrest, citing court documents. Linkvist is charged with financing extremist activity under Part 1 of Article 282.3 of Russia’s Criminal Code and faces up to eight years in prison. Linkvist, 57, has run Vtoroi Front since 1995. The chain sells military gear and has three stores in Moscow. The Insider found that Linkvist signed four government contracts totaling 2.23 million rubles with military unit 92154 in 2016 and 2017. That number identifies the 322nd Special Purpose Center, known as Senezh, one of the most secretive units of the GRU, Russia’s military intelligence agency. Publicly available data shows that Linkvist is Senezh’s third-largest supplier. Troops from the unit took part in Russian military operations in Ukraine and Syria and have been linked to preparations for acts of sabotage, The Insider reported. Russian authorities designated the Anti-Corruption Foundation an “extremist” organization in 2021. Since then, authorities have opened at least 225 criminal cases over donations to the foundation. Sentences in these cases have ranged from heavy fines to prison time. Biologist Sofya Rozenfeld, for example, was sentenced to three and a half years in a penal colony for two donations of 1,000 rubles each to the foundation, while IT manager Alexander Lunev was fined 570,000 rubles for a 7,000-ruble donation. title: 特朗普预计中国将添购250架波音飞机
content_preview: 美国总统特朗普预计，中国将再添购250架波音飞机。这是波音持续推动对华销售的最新进展，在近10年基本无缘中国市场后，这家美国飞机制造商重新获得进入全球第二大航空市场的机会。 据彭博社报道，这次新增飞机采购是在特朗普今年5月含糊宣布，中国将购买200架“大型”飞机之后。不过，波音首席执行官奥特伯格（Kelly Ortberg）在10月表示，这并非确定订单，只是中方表达了购买意向。 特朗普在星期一（11月23日）接受美国消费者新闻与商业频道（CNBC）采访时说：“我是波音飞机的销售之王，但你知道，你得把飞机造出来。看看波音的积压订单，简直难以置信。波音授予我‘世纪最佳推销员’奖。” 截至纽约时间下午12时43分，波音股价上涨4%至162美元（209新元），势将创8月初以来最大涨幅。 外界此前普遍预计，中国政府将在5月中国国家主席习近平与特朗普举行峰会时同意购买最多500架飞机，但北京及中国航司迄今尚未公布更多细节。 目前尚不清楚特朗普周一的表态是否意味着订单已经敲定，也不清楚这批飞机包括哪些机型。 中美元首9月峰会前夕，美国贸易代表格里尔（Jamieson Greer）透露，中国正推进落实今年5月宣布的购买200架波音飞机的承诺，但未说明中方近期是否会追加订单。 格里尔9月21日接受福克斯新闻访问时说，“其中约140架的订单进展良好，另外10架的订单正在拟定中。” 这批订单是波音近十年来在中国取得的首笔重大订单。美国总统特朗普今年5月曾说，中国向波音订购的飞机数量可能增至750架。

title: Finnish lawmakers back anti-tank barriers along border with Russia
content_preview: Heikki Autto, chairman of the Finnish parliament’s defense committee, has backed plans to build anti-tank barriers along the border with Russia, Bloomberg reported. Ukraine’s experience shows that these structures must be built in peacetime, he said. “If you let the enemy take 50 kilometers in the very beginning of the hostilities, it seems you’ll hardly be able to push them back later,” Autto said. Finland’s military has traditionally allowed for ceding some territory if necessary, drawing the enemy deeper into the country before counterattacking from more advantageous positions, according to Bloomberg. Fortifying the border in peacetime marks a break from “traditional Finnish military thinking,” Autto said. Mika Kari, a defense committee member from the opposition Social Democratic Party, also backed the plan. He said that although Finland accounts for about half of NATO’s border with Russia, reinforcing the border should be considered part of the alliance’s overall defense rather than Finland’s internal problem. In the fall of 2023, Finland closed all checkpoints along its land border with Russia, and by September 2026 had finished building a 200-kilometer (124-mile) fence along the border. The project cost 356 million euros. Earlier in November, the German tabloid Bild reported that Moscow had demanded Finland withdraw from NATO during informal talks on ending Russia’s war against Ukraine. The Kremlin denied this. Finnish President Alexander Stubb said that Finland has no plans to leave NATO and that he had never heard of such a demand from Russia. title: Russia detains Murmansk region Governor Andrey Chibis on suspicion of embezzlement
content_preview: Update : Russia’s Interior Ministry has officially confirmed that Andrey Chibis has been detained. He is suspected of stealing 39 million rubles in public funds, embezzling 1 billion rubles, and conducting illegal foreign exchange transactions. Andrey Chibis, the governor of Russia’s Murmansk region, has been detained on suspicion of theft and investigators are taking steps in the case involving him, TASS and RBC reported. Telegram channels ( 1 , 2 ) reported that the governor was answering investigators’ questions in Moscow. The channels did not say what investigators were asking him about or whether they were questioning him as a witness, a suspect, or in some other capacity. People close to Chibis told the news outlet Ostorozhno, Novosti that he was in Moscow “on a business trip” and that he “wasn’t brought there” by authorities. According to Mash , Chibis was “pulled right off the plane’s stairs” when he arrived in Moscow. He is suspected of involvement in “misconduct involving government contracts” for road repairs. Investigators carried out inquiries at the Murmansk regional government building on November 23, the Telegram channel Arktichesky Obozrevatel (Arctic Observer) reported . Law enforcement officers had gone to the region’s Construction Ministry several days earlier. Law enforcement officers also questioned Sergey Dolgov, the regional security minister, and Oksana Demchenko, the region’s first deputy governor, on November 23. Chibis has led the Murmansk region since 2019. In 2024, he was attacked with a knife during a meeting with residents of the town of Apatity. cn_summary: 据市政负责人鲁斯兰·霍门科报告，赫尔松地区近期遭受了大规模袭击。仅在阿廖什基一地，就记录了464次火炮和迫击炮袭击，以及440次无人机袭击。这些袭击造成了严重的人员伤亡，包括两名平民死亡和七人受伤。当地局势持续紧张，基础设施受损严重。
impact: 地区冲突的加剧加剧了全球地缘政治风险，可能导致能源和粮食价格波动，对中国宏观经济的输入性通胀压力产生潜在影响。此类冲突带来的不稳定性可能抑制全球投资信心，对依赖海外市场的中国企业构成挑战。对于青年毕业生，应关注国际局势对相关行业（如物流、能源）就业机会的潜在冲击。

title: 俄船只遇袭 阿尔巴尼亚否认袭击自其领土发起
content_preview: 阿尔巴尼亚欧洲事务和外交部23日发表声明称，阿方注意到有报道称，对俄罗斯护卫舰的海上无人机袭击自阿尔巴尼亚领土发起。声明指出，这些报道不准确，与事实不符。阿尔巴尼亚没有参与此次事件，阿方领土既没有被用于、也没有被提供用于发动或协助任何此类袭击。 声明还说，阿方坚决否认这些毫无证据的指控，呼吁传播相关信息者予以更正，并在报道此类敏感问题时秉持准确、审慎、负责的态度。（央视）

cn_summary: 顿涅茨克市长阿列克谢·库列姆津表示，当地发生了一起无人机袭击事件。袭击目标为尤日内汽车站，造成七人受伤。此外，市政道路维修与建设部门的多辆车辆在袭击中受损。目前相关部门正在评估损失情况并进行现场清理。该事件再次凸显了冲突地区基础设施面临的安全威胁。
impact: 此类地缘政治冲突加剧了全球供应链的不确定性，可能间接推高大宗商品价格，对中国进口成本产生波动影响。对于中国青年群体而言，地缘局势的动荡增加了海外就业和跨国业务拓展的风险，促使更多人才回流国内市场。

title: FEDS Paper: Where's The Bank? Banking Access in the Era of Branch Consolidation(Revised)
content_preview: Robert M. Adams and Shane M. Sherlund The number of U.S. bank branches fell more than 19 log points between 2014 and 2024, prompting concerns about eroding access to banking services. We study this contraction using a free-entry, two-dimensional spatial competition model in the tradition of Lösch and Hotelling. The model predicts that equilibrium branch density scales linearly with local customer density and that the elasticity of mean nearest-branch distance with respect to the number of branches is -1/2 . Using branch locations and census-block-level data on households and employment, we estimate elasticities between -0.37 and -0.52. These lie near the two-dimensional prediction and reject the -1 implied by one-dimensional models. Differences in branch access across demographic groups are economically small, and they did not widen over the decade. The branch contraction is consistent with the equilibrium response of a competitive spatial system to an industry-wide profitability shock, rather than a localized withdrawal of service.

title: 国际金价冲高回落 业内人士：宏观层面压制并未实质消除
content_preview: 在创下阶段新低3502美元/盎司之后，伦敦现货黄金价格迎来反弹，一度逼近3700美元/盎司，此后则再次承压。Wind数据显示，截至北京时间11月24日14:55，伦敦现货黄金报3630.12美元/盎司，此前交易日最高一度触及3689.67美元/盎司。 国信期货表示，此番贵金属技术性反弹，源于超跌后的空头回补叠加国际油价大幅下挫。此前金银价格持续下行，市场对于美联储持续加息的悲观预期集中释放，盘面深度超卖，不少空头在关键整数关口选择止盈离场。与此同时，中东供应增加、利比亚输油管道重启带动国际油价大跌，一定程度缓和了市场对美国通胀黏性的担忧，给无息贵金属带来阶段性修复窗口。不过，宏观层面的压制并未实质消除。受英伟达相关消息刺激，市场风险偏好回升，交易端再度押注美联储维持偏鹰立场，叠加强美元、高利率预期持续约束，金银上行空间受限。（中证金牛座）

title: At least 720,000 Russian soldiers killed in Ukraine by fall 2026, Meduza and Mediazona estimate in new analysis that includes missing troops for the first time
content_preview: At least 720,000 Russian armed forces personnel had died in the war in Ukraine by fall 2026, according to a new analysis by Meduza and Mediazona. The estimate is the first to include personnel listed as missing. Meduza and Mediazona were able to analyze deaths among these soldiers using a model drawn from mathematics and epidemiology. New sources made the research possible, chiefly a Rosstat database hacked by the Belarusian Cyber-Partisans and Silent Crow hacker groups in early November 2026. Excluding soldiers missing in action whose deaths have not yet been registered, Meduza and Mediazona estimate that more than 490,000 Russian soldiers had been killed as of the end of September 2026. title: A geography teacher joked about closing a window before telling his class how many regions Russia has. He says someone reported him, likely over the video.
content_preview: Vitaly Nikitin, a geography teacher in Yekaterinburg who posts videos on social media about teaching at a Russian school, said on Threads that someone had filed a complaint against him. His posts were picked up by Krovavaya Barynya, Ksenia Sobchak’s Telegram channel. Nikitin teaches at Secondary School No. 85. He has almost 4,000 followers on Instagram and 1,500 on TikTok . In one of his most popular videos , Nikitin simply closes a window as Sergei Lazarev’s song “O bozhe, dai mne sil” (“Oh, God, Give Me Strength”) plays. “This is me closing the window so no one walking by can hear me explain to my ninth graders how many regions Russia has,” the caption reads. On Instagram, the video has drawn 1.7 million views and almost 90,000 likes. View this post on Instagram The video likely prompted the complaint. Nikitin said it came from one of his TikTok viewers, who claimed the teacher’s actions amounted to a public call to undermine Russia’s territorial integrity, an offense under Article 280.1 of Russia’s Criminal Code. “Basically, they accused me of urging people to undermine Russia’s territorial integrity and sovereignty,” Nikitin said. It’s unclear who received the complaint. Nikitin said he had to submit a written explanation to the school’s principal in response. cn_title: 黄仁勋回归后亚洲英伟达概念股大涨，台湾相关股票逼近涨停
cn_summary: 在英伟达董事会重新确认CEO黄仁勋的职务后，投资者重新涌入科技市场。这一领导层稳定消息迅速提振了亚洲相关供应链的信心。台湾地区的多只英伟达概念股盘中大涨，逼近价格涨停板。市场对人工智能芯片未来的强劲需求再次表示乐观。科技板块整体情绪因此得到显著修复。
impact: 该事件对中国宏观经济的直接影响有限，但对A股及港股的半导体、人工智能及消费电子板块具有较强的风向标作用。随着亚洲科技股走强，相关产业链的信心有望恢复，从而间接带动国内高技术制造业的投资热度。在就业市场方面，半导体与AI产业链景气度的回升，将有利于缓解相关专业毕业生的就业压力，创造更多高附加值的技术岗位。

title: 黄仁勋复职 台股行情逆转涨超9%
content_preview: 美国晶片巨头英伟达创办人黄仁勋复职，美股四大指数全数收涨，带动亚太市场。台湾加权指数星期二（11月24日）大涨超9%。 英伟达董事会星期一（11月23日）一致通过恢复联合创办人黄仁勋的总裁、首席执行官和董事职务，决议即时生效。消息带动英伟达及半导体板块上涨。 亚太股市星期二开盘普涨。台湾加权指数收盘大涨3310.46 点，创下台股史上最大单日收盘涨点纪录；较前一交易日收盘上涨约8.99%；台积电涨9.85%，多达622家台股上市企业涨停。 香港恒生指数和恒生科技指数一度上涨，但午后均转跌。中国大陆三大指数也高开低走，沪指收涨0.27%，深成指跌0.29%，创业板指数跌0.05%。

cn_title: 民调显示多数德国人反对向基辅提供军事支持
cn_summary: 最新民调显示，德国民众对继续向乌克兰提供援助的支持率在一年内从59%下降至46%。这一趋势反映了德国国内对于长期卷入地缘政治冲突的担忧加剧。随着能源价格波动和经济压力增大，民众对外交政策的关注点正发生偏移。多数受访者开始对持续的军事投入持保留态度。
impact: 欧洲对乌援助态度的转变可能引发地缘政治不确定性，进而影响全球供应链及大宗商品价格。对中国而言，这增加了外部环境的复杂性。虽然对国内就业市场无直接冲击，但地缘政治波动可能影响中欧贸易往来，间接影响外贸相关行业的就业稳定性。

title: 【海关总署公告2026年第162号（关于进一步规范进出口化妆品安全监管要求的公告）】为了加强进出口化妆品安全监管，保障消
content_preview: 【海关总署公告2026年第162号（关于进一步规范进出口化妆品安全监管要求的公告）】为了加强进出口化妆品安全监管，保障消费者健康权益，根据《中华人民共和国海关法》、《中华人民共和国进出口商品检验法》及其实施条例、《化妆品监督管理条例》、《中华人民共和国海关进出口化妆品检验检疫监督管理办法》等规定，现就进一步规范进出口化妆品安全监管有关事项公告如下： 一、关于进口化妆品标签要求 进口化妆品中文标签内容应当与在国家药监部门化妆品注册备案信息服务平台中的产品标签样稿相关内容一致。 进口免税化妆品免予加贴中文标签，海南离岛免税化妆品除外。 跨境电子商务零售进口化妆品标签按相关规定执行。 二、关于出口检验检疫申请单填报要求 出口化妆品的生产企业、发货人或其代理人，应当按照相关要求如实、完整、规范填报各项申报信息。其中，企业资质及商品信息填报有关要求如下： （一）企业资质填报要求。 在“企业资质编号”项目中选择“616－化妆品生产许可证”，填报化妆品生产企业名称及生产许可证编号。 （二）商品信息填报要求。 在“商品信息”栏目下“产品资质”项目中，填报该产品在国家药监部门化妆品注册备案信息服务平台的注册或备案编号。 本公告自2026年12月1日起实施。此前海关总署发布的有关进出口化妆品相关规定与本公告不一致的，以本公告为准。 特此公告。

title: She moved from Russia to Germany to work as a nanny. She ended up founding a learning center for Russian-speaking children — and winning over skeptical local officials.
content_preview: The new subject of our “Emigrant Questionnaire” column is Alexandra Konopleva, who has lived in Germany for almost 14 years now. In Russia, Alexandra worked in a kindergarten, a school, and summer camps, and she moved to Germany as a nanny under the Au Pair program. Here she completed a master’s degree (even though she couldn’t understand what people were saying to her during her entrance exams) and founded an educational center for Russian-speaking children called Chemodan Skazok (“Suitcase of Fairy Tales”). She also became a volunteer firefighter, made a documentary film, and joined her city council. What’s your name? My name is Alexandra. Where do you live, and how long have you lived there? I live in a small village outside Hanover and have lived in Germany for almost 14 years. I moved to Germany almost by accident. In Russia, I studied to become a social worker and psychologist at MPGU . During and after my studies, I worked with children: in a kindergarten, a school, and summer camps. I was good at it, but I didn’t know what I wanted to do next. Sunset from Alexandra’s window I realized I knew very little about life outside Russia. I’d always loved to travel and had taken plenty of trips abroad, but those were short, budget tourist trips. I decided it would be great to try living in another country. At first, I spent a long time trying to get into a European youth exchange program . Looking back, I realize my motivation letters were weak and repetitive. On top of that, my written English was poor, and I didn’t know German at all. I applied again and again, but no one accepted me. I chose Germany for one simple reason: “Why not?” I had vacationed there a few times and remembered the clean streets and the delicious bakery buns. Moving to Germany for work without knowing the language was unrealistic, so I took what seemed like the easiest path: I moved to a village in Lower Saxony to work as an au pair for an ordinary German family. I thought I’d work for the fam

title: 所罗门群岛将与澳大利亚签署一项新协议，外交部：有关合作不应针对第三方
content_preview: 外交部发言人郭嘉昆主持例行记者会。有外媒记者提问，据《悉尼先驱晨报》报道，所罗门群岛已通知中方，决定终止双方于2022年签署的具有里程碑意义的安全合作协议，该协议将于明年4月到期。外交部能否证实这一消息？此外，对于有关所罗门群岛将于明天与澳大利亚签署一项新协议的报道，外交部有何评论？ 郭嘉昆表示，中方始终秉持相互尊重、平等相待的原则发展同所罗门群岛关系。中国同包括所罗门群岛在内的太平洋岛国合作不搞地缘博弈，不搞集团对抗，不针对第三方，也不受第三方影响。国际社会应共同帮助太平洋岛国实现可持续发展，坚持岛国自主、发展为先、开放包容，有关合作不应针对第三方。（澎湃）

title: BBC以“另一面”为题报道深圳 《环球时报》批“阴间滤镜”
content_preview: 英国广播公司（BBC）在亚太经济合作组织（APEC）领导人非正式会议召开前夕，刊文报道深圳科技繁荣背后，传统产业工人面临的就业和收入压力。中国《环球时报》发文批评BBC使用“阴间滤镜”，进行选择性和误导性报道，要求BBC向深圳市民道歉。 BBC上星期二（11月17日）刊发题为《中国以AI奇境接待各国领袖，但他们看不到的另一面是什么？》（China is hosting the world’s leaders in its AI wonderland. Here’s what they won’t see）的报道，通过实地走访深圳科技企业和传统制造业聚集区，呈现中国科技发展过程中不同群体的境遇。 报道一方面介绍深圳无人机配送、自动驾驶出租车和人形机器人等科技创新成果，另一方面则将镜头转向沙井、松岗等传统制造业聚集区，关注工厂外迁、工人收入下滑，以及劳动者对人工智能（AI）时代就业前景的担忧。 BBC报道称，受房地产市场低迷和消费疲软影响，一些制造商缩减生产规模、推进自动化，或将工厂迁往劳动力成本更低的地区，越来越多工人转向薪酬和福利相对较低的零工经济。 《环球时报》星期一（23日）发表题为《BBC应向被冒犯的深圳市民道歉》的快评，指责BBC通过剪辑和画面处理，将普通深圳市民的生活呈现得阴暗诡异，以迎合预设的报道结论。 评论称，BBC并非看不到中国的科技进步，而是习惯于对中国的发展成就附加负面解读。这种报道方式不仅冒犯深圳市民，也冒犯BBC的全球读者。 《环球时报》还指责BBC长期在涉华报道中存在偏见，并将此上升至种族主义问题。评论称，随着赴华外国游客越来越多，西方媒体过去构建的舆论屏障已被打破。

title: 中国—墨西哥高层工作组第十一次会议在京举行
content_preview: 11月23日，商务部部长王文涛与墨西哥经济部长埃布拉德在北京共同主持召开中墨高层工作组第十一次会议，双方就中墨经贸关系等议题进行坦诚、深入交流。 王文涛表示，中方愿同墨方一道，落实好两国元首达成的重要共识，深化各领域务实合作，通过对话协商拓展共同利益，以2026年两国建交55周年为新起点，不断丰富中墨全面战略伙伴关系内涵。中方敦促墨方重视涉华关税等严正关切，审慎使用贸易救济措施，妥善处理中资企业在墨投资遇到的问题，以实际行动维护双边经贸合作大局，免受第三方干扰。 双方同意继续发挥现有高层工作组的机制作用，进一步推动双边经贸关系健康、稳定、可持续发展。（商务部网站）

title: 黑龙江：引导金融机构加强对创新药企业的投融资支持 鼓励商业保险扩大创新药支付范围
content_preview: 黑龙江省人民政府印发《黑龙江省卫生健康发展“十五五”规划》，其中提出，支持创新药和医疗器械发展。支持医疗机构与科研院所、企业协同开展创新药临床试验和医疗器械研发，促进基础研究成果向临床诊疗方案转化。加快细胞和基因治疗药物、新型抗体、新型疫苗、核酸药物、放射性药物等应用，提升应急疫苗和药物使用能力，丰富儿童用药品种。推动人工智能赋能医药全产业链升级。落实医保支持创新药和医疗器械高质量发展机制。引导金融机构加强对创新药企业的投融资支持，鼓励商业保险扩大创新药支付范围。

cn_title: 欧洲央行西姆库斯称在通胀扩大之际加息是“明智之举”
cn_summary: 欧洲央行管理委员会委员格迪米纳斯·西姆库斯指出，随着价格上涨压力从石油领域向更广泛的经济部门蔓延，欧洲央行将利率提升至开始对经济产生限制作用的水平是“明智的”。价格压力的广泛化意味着通胀具有更强的粘性，需要更广范围的货币紧缩予以应对。央行正在通过提高借贷成本来为主体经济降温。这一政策取向凸显了管理通胀预期的紧迫性。西姆库斯的言论为欧洲持续的加息周期提供了强有力的政策辩护。
impact: 欧洲加息应对广泛通胀的举措强化了全球央行对抗通胀的决心，外部输入性通胀压力对中国政策制定形成参考。全球总需求的放缓对中国外贸出口增速带来下行压力，进而影响相关产业链企业的利润与扩张计划。外贸及跨国供应链领域的青年就业岗位增幅可能受限，高校毕业生的求职选择需更加多元化。

title: 中国外交部：中国不搞地缘争夺 不搞势力范围
content_preview: 针对中美俄元首会晤对话机制若常态化会否削弱现有多边机制，中国外交部回应时说，中国不搞地缘争夺，不搞势力范围，而是在相互尊重、平等相待的基础上，同各国开展友好交往。 中国外交部发言人郭嘉昆星期一（11月23日）在例行记者会上回应阿纳多卢通讯社提问时，作出上述表述。 他说，中方一贯主张大小国家一律平等，致力于实现国际关系民主化，构建平等有序的世界多极化。中方将继续践行真正的多边主义，携手构建人类命运共同体。 阿纳多卢通讯社另一提问指，中美俄元首会晤发布的《和平宣言》提及，三国元首认可国家同意原则和尊重国家官员享有豁免至关重要，一致认为国际刑事法院以及其他类似机构不得滥用管辖权。国际刑事法院曾主导针对以色列总理和前防长的调查，并就其犯下战争罪及危害人类罪签发逮捕令。中方是否认为这构成了司法权力滥用？在这些案件中应当如何界定豁免权？ 郭嘉昆应询时说，在巴勒斯坦问题上，中方支持任何有助于实现公平正义、维护国际法权威的努力。中方一贯主张国际刑事法院应秉持客观公正立场，依法行使职权，按照统一标准全面善意解释和适用《罗马规约》和一般国际法。 阿纳多卢通讯社同日再问及，乌克兰总统泽连斯基称，在乌方未出席的会议上讨论乌克兰危机是“错误”的。请问中俄美元首会晤是否讨论了乌克兰危机？ 郭嘉昆说，关于乌克兰危机，中方的立场是一贯、明确的，始终认为对话谈判是解决危机的唯一可行出路。中方支持一切有利于和平的努力。

title: 油价下跌缓解通胀担忧 美国国债价格上涨
content_preview: 随着油价下跌缓解市场对通胀的担忧，美国国债全线走高。与此同时，黄仁勋重返英伟达重新激发了投资者对风险资产的兴趣，美债的涨势因而格外引人注目。基准10年期美国国债收益率下行3个基点，对美联储政策前景更为敏感的2年期美国国债收益率也下行3个基点。 受市场对结束美伊战争的努力抱持审慎乐观态度影响，油价上一交易日下跌逾3%。债市走势显示，相较于AI股票交易卷土重来可能造成的影响，投资者更关注能源价格下跌可能促使美联储缓和鹰派立场。通常而言，AI股票交易回暖会削弱对避险资产的需求。

title: One in five Russian businesses in Dubai has closed since 2022
content_preview: About 21% of businesses owned by Russian entrepreneurs have left Dubai since 2022, Sabina Gasanova, founder of the Emirati legalization and document processing agency Wesupport, told Forbes Russia. The war in the Middle East and a decline in tourist traffic were partly to blame, but many Russian companies ran into trouble even before the war began, Forbes Russia wrote. As many as half a million Russians relocated to Dubai in 2022, according to various estimates. The emirate attracted entrepreneurs with low taxes, relatively simple visa requirements, and the purchasing power of potential clients. However, many companies never gained a foothold in the market, due to competition from local players or poorly chosen business models. According to the consulting firm Nikoliers, 30 of 107 Russian clothing and restaurant brands closed in Dubai in the third quarter of 2026 alone. As many as half a million Russians relocated to Dubai in 2022, according to various estimates. The emirate attracted entrepreneurs with low taxes, relatively simple visa requirements, and the purchasing power of potential clients. However, many companies never gained a foothold in the market, due to competition from local players or poorly chosen business models. According to the consulting firm Nikoliers, 30 of 107 Russian clothing and restaurant brands closed in Dubai in the third quarter of 2026 alone. title: Russia’s statistics agency listed heart disease as the cause of Ukrainian journalist Viktoriia Roshchyna’s death in Russian custody, leaked records show
content_preview: Official Russian documents attribute Ukrainian journalist Viktoriia Roshchyna’s death in Russian custody to heart disease and pulmonary edema. BBC News Russian , Verstka , and iStories reported the finding after reviewing leaked data from Rosstat, Russia’s federal statistics agency. Roshchyna went missing in Ukraine’s occupied territories in August 2023 and died in Russian captivity on September 19, 2024. She was 27. The reporters found that the first entry about Roshchyna in Rosstat’s registry appeared in December 2024. Her date of death was initially listed as December 16, 2024, and later changed to September 19. The entry gave neither a cause nor a manner of death. In February 2025, the cause of death was entered as “myocardial degeneration” — damage to heart muscle tissue. On February 11, three days before Roshchyna’s body was returned to Ukraine, “disease” was entered in the “manner of death” field. “Myocardial degeneration” remained the underlying cause, and pulmonary edema was listed as the immediate cause. Roshchyna was captured in August 2023 in Enerhodar, a city seized by Russian forces. She had traveled to the occupied Zaporizhzhia region to report for Ukrainska Pravda as a freelancer. For several months, she was held in police stations and pretrial detention centers in various cities, both in occupied territory and in Russia. Witnesses said she was tortured in custody, that her weight dropped to 30 kilograms (about 66 pounds), and that she couldn’t walk without help. She was expected to be on the list for a September 2024 prisoner-of-war exchange, but Russian authorities announced that she had died. Her body, which bore signs of torture, was handed over to Ukraine in February 2025. The Ukrainian Prosecutor General’s Office said Roshchyna had been held in a pretrial detention center in Taganrog, in Russia’s Rostov region. According to the investigative outlet Slidstvo.Info, before her death she was held in Pretrial Detention Center No. 3 in the town of Ki

cn_summary: 一家运营东京23区中六家火葬场的私营企业，其母公司有35%的股份由中国企业持有。这一股权结构在日本当地引发了关于公共基础设施安全的担忧与讨论。火葬场作为核心城市民生设施，其外资参股背景触动了敏感的社会神经。相关议题反映出日本社会对关键基础设施涉外资本的审视趋严。这也凸显了在全球化资本流动背景下，地方民生服务安全与跨国投资审查之间的微妙平衡。
impact: 该事件对中国宏观经济无直接实质影响，但反映出日本及部分海外市场对中资企业投资基础设施的审视和敏感度正在上升。对于中国企业而言，未来在海外特别是发达国家参与民生、公用事业等敏感领域的投资时，需更加注重合规透明与舆论沟通。对中国就业市场和青年毕业生而言，直接影响微乎其微，但提示出海企业在跨国合规管理方面需要更多专业涉外法律与公关人才。

cn_summary: 欧洲央行管理委员会委员西姆库斯呼吁，欧洲央行应当尽可能早地采取先发制人的政策行动。面对复杂多变的经济和通胀形势，提前布局有助于掌握调控的主动权。这种预防性策略能够避免未来因通胀失控而被迫采取更为激进的紧缩措施。及时调整货币政策方向是确保中期价格稳定的关键所在。这一表态暗示了央行决策层倾向于保持政策的前瞻性和灵活性。
impact: 欧洲央行采取更具前瞻性的货币紧缩倾向，有助于加速全球主要经济体金融周期的调整。中国宏观经济在应对外部输入性金融波动时，需保持国内政策的独立性和针对性。相关紧缩外溢效应可能对国内资本市场情绪及外向型企业的融资环境产生边际影响。

title: 《半导体设备与零部件质量管理体系》行业标准发布
content_preview: 【《半导体设备与零部件质量管理体系》行业标准发布】财联社11月24日电，据工业和信息化部消息，我国半导体设备与零部件行业首个专属质量管理体系标准——《半导体设备与零部件质量管理体系》正式发布。据了解，半导体制造工艺步骤繁多、要求严苛，所用到的设备与零部件呈现多品种、小批量、高定制、高精密的特点，对洁净度、可靠性、一致性要求极高。ISO9001通用质量管理体系标准无法匹配半导体产业的特殊要求，亟须制定行业专属质量管理体系标准。《半导体设备与零部件质量管理体系》将系统规范半导体设备与零部件全生命周期质量管理。

cn_title: 萨特克利夫：美国似乎准备重新接触伊朗
cn_summary: 由于市场对结束美伊战争努力的谨慎乐观情绪，国际油价应声走低。据Axios报道，尽管美国总统此前威胁若谈判失败将于明年恢复打击，但副总统万斯仍会见了卡塔尔首相以讨论与伊朗的谈判事宜。彭博社中东和非洲首席分析师梅根·萨特克利夫在节目中分析了这一地缘政治动向。美伊关系的任何缓和迹象都将对中东地区的能源供给和地缘格局产生深远影响。国际社会正密切关注外交接触能否有效化解长期的军事对峙。
impact: 国际油价的回落有利于降低中国作为全球最大原油进口国的能源采购成本，从而在宏观层面上减轻输入型通胀压力，改善制造企业的生产经营利润。在中东地缘政治趋稳的背景下，中国企业在海湾地区的能源贸易、基础设施建设和投资活动面临更加稳定的外部环境。对于涉外能源、国际经贸、外交及区域研究等专业的青年毕业生而言，中东局势的演变及中国与中东国家经贸合作的深化，将创造更多跨国就业与海外派驻的发展机遇。

title: 黑龙江：为育龄人群提供生育力评估和分类指导 努力保持适度生育水平
content_preview: 黑龙江 省人民政府印发《黑龙江省卫生健康发展“十五五”规划》。其中提到，实施生育率提升专项行动，优化补贴、保险、医疗、住房保障等全方位生育支持举措。为育龄人群提供生育力评估和分类指导，规范不孕不育诊治服务，努力保持适度生育水平。实施早孕关爱行动、孕育和出生缺陷防治能力提升计划，规范辅助生殖技术管理应用，实现怀胎分娩全周期保障。强化出生缺陷三级防治，推广产前筛查与新生儿基因疾病筛查，从源头提升人口素质。健全计划生育特殊家庭全方位帮扶保障制度。完善生育保险制度，扩大生育保险参保覆盖面，提升生育医疗费用保障水平，基本实现政策范围内住院分娩个人“无自付”，优化生育津贴发放流程。推动婴幼儿参加基本医疗保险资助参保政策落地。

cn_summary: 周一，标普500指数和纳斯达克综合指数创下了自2025年4月以来的最佳单日表现，人工智能相关板块强劲复苏。目前，股指期货进一步上涨，投资者正密切关注英伟达能否在创始人黄仁勋回归的带动下，继续延续近期的强劲涨势。人工智能概念股的持续活跃提振了市场的整体风险偏好。投资者正评估科技巨头的创新动能对整体美股市场的带动作用。
impact: 美股人工智能板块的波动直接影响全球资本市场的风险偏好，进而对中国宏观经济的资本流动和科技股估值产生间接溢出效应。在就业市场上，全球人工智能产业的景气度直接决定了国内互联网和高科技企业的招聘需求。对于计算机、人工智能等相关专业的应届毕业生而言，海外AI巨头的业绩与股价表现是行业景气的重要风向标，影响着国内高端技术人才的薪酬水平和就业机会。

title: 快手生活服务重启服务商和商户补贴
content_preview: 从多位知情人士处获悉，今年11月起，快手生活服务面向服务商和商户发布了新一轮补贴政策用于拉新。 其中，商户可获得快手平台GMV 1%-5%的补贴；服务商可根据拉新商户的类目及星级获得不同的返点激励，综合（超市购物、服装等）和酒旅类目的激励普遍高于餐饮，服务商最高可获得3.5%的激励。 同时，服务商还可获得新开激励：新开店每店可获得50元奖励，门槛是该店累计动销金额500元以上支付或者有5笔2.9元以上的订单。此外，平台还有以核销流水为门槛的返点，比如达到100万元核销能拿到对应返点。 这是快手生活服务业务暂停近一年之后，再次重启商户和服务商补贴。记者向快手方面求证此事，截至发稿，对方暂未回应。（界面）

cn_title: 电动与混合动力汽车占据欧洲汽车市场四分之三份额
cn_summary: 欧洲汽车制造商协会最新数据显示，上个月欧洲新能源汽车销量实现爆发式增长，电动与混合动力汽车占新车注册总量的75%左右。与此同时，传统汽油和柴油车销量大幅下降，凸显出市场需求对高昂能源商品价格的高度敏感性。其中，纯电动汽车销量约占欧盟总数的29.8%，插电式混合动力汽车占比达10.9%。这一趋势表明欧洲汽车产业向绿色转型正在加速推进。能源危机在客观上重塑了消费者的购车偏好。
impact: 欧洲汽车市场的全面电动化对中国宏观经济及新能源汽车出口带来重要机遇与竞争压力。国内新能源产业链面临广阔的出海空间，相关制造和研发领域的就业吸纳能力进一步增强。对于中国青年毕业生而言，新能源汽车、电池技术及出海供应链等相关领域的岗位需求旺盛，为理工科及国际化人才提供了优质的就业机遇。

cn_title: 随着黄仁勋回归重振AI交易，新兴市场股市强势反弹
cn_summary: 随着黄仁勋重新掌舵英伟达公司，全球投资者对人工智能（AI）板块的热情被再次点燃并大量买入相关股票。受此乐观情绪鼓舞，新兴市场股市迎来了自7月以来的最大单日涨幅。科技股的走强带动了整体风险资产的回暖，资金重新流入新兴经济体。市场信心在经历前期波动后显现修复迹象。AI产业链的核心驱动力再次成为全球资本市场的重要风向标。
impact: 全球AI概念的回暖和新兴市场股市反弹，有助于提振中国宏观经济中的科技板块情绪与外资信心。在就业市场上，人工智能、半导体及数字经济相关高技术领域的投资增加，将直接扩大企业的用人需求。对于中国青年毕业生特别是计算机、人工智能及相关专业的应届生而言，技术创新带来的产业扩张创造了大量高质量的就业岗位。

title: Russia protests Estonia’s planned land border closure and again accuses it of letting Ukrainian drones use its airspace
content_preview: Russia’s Foreign Ministry summoned Estonia’s acting chargé d’affaires in Moscow, Marek Juhtegi, and lodged a “strong protest” over Estonia’s accusation that Moscow tried to set fire to a defense plant and the Estonian government’s decision to close the border with Russia. The ministry said Estonia’s accusations were “entirely unsupported by evidence” and that closing the border would “deal another blow to Estonia’s economy and backfire on both Tallinn and its EU and NATO allies.” The ministry also accused Estonia of “quietly allowing Ukrainian drones to fly through its airspace” to attack Russia. The ministry said Russia had “objectively documented those flights with evidence on more than one occasion.” “We again warned the Estonian diplomat that such provocative and extremely dangerous actions come close to triggering open war with Russia,” the ministry said. The Estonian government has decided to close all land border crossings with Russia for at least six months, starting December 1. The decision was prompted by an attempt to set fire to a Threod Systems defense plant. Estonian authorities believe Russian intelligence orchestrated the sabotage. Estonia’s president, Ülle Madise , and the mayor of Narva disagreed with the government’s decision. Russia has repeatedly accused the Baltic states of letting Ukrainian drones fly through their airspace to attack Russia. The Baltic states deny this. title: 宏福苑大火改革汇报 李家超要求尽速修订六法严打围标
content_preview: 香港特首李家超听取大埔宏福苑大火改革进度报告时，要求尽速修订六条法例，并严打围标。 据香港政府公报，李家超星期一（11月23日）在特首主持会议，听取官员汇报港府为防止大埔宏福苑火灾事故再发生的系统改革和推行独立委员会报告建议的进度报告。 他指示各政策局和部门全力推展改革工作，尽快将六条法例的修订草案提交立法会审议，要求跨部门特遣队全力出击严打围标，以及尽快落实成立楼宇维修支援及服务局等新措施。 香港大埔宏福苑去年11月26日发生致命大火，造成168人罹难。 港府今年10月29日公开独立委员会报告，并公布以独立委员会报告建议为基础推行六方面的系统性改革。之后，香港政务司司长陈国基在10月30日设立督导委员会，在11月16日的首次会议逐一检视独立委员会建议推进落实方案，其中29项已完成。 六条法例的修订工作正如期推展，香港保安局将在下月将《消防条例》修订草案提交立法会进行首读及二读；香港民政及青年事务局已于11月9日向立法会汇报修订建议，正敲定修订条文细节，将尽快提交《建筑物管理条例》草案。 香港发展局在星期二（11月24日）的立法会发展事务委员会会议向委员汇报修订建议，目标在明年初提交《建筑物条例》草案；香港商务及经济发展局正联同相关部门全速推进法律草拟工作，明年初将向立法会提交修订《竞争条例》、《有组织及严重罪行条例》和《廉政公署条例》草案，全面打击楼宇维修工程围标等反竞争行为。 在加强工程监管及支援业主方面，楼宇维修支援及服务局将在今年内正式成立，下月起陆续编制和管理三张“预审名单”，明年1月起向业主指派验楼顾问，并在首季内为业主进行项目招标。 香港发展局将在本月内成立楼宇大型维修专家小组，希望12月开展工作，成员将包括专家学者、业界和政府部门，为楼宇大型维修的宏观标准、指引提建议。 香港房屋局公营房屋楼宇管制组星期一成立，取代原有的独立审查组。新监管制度以每个屋苑的大型维修项目为基础作综合监管。目前已成立项目专队，协助五个正进行大型维修工程的屋苑，并派驻联络专员直接与屋苑业主立案法团沟通。 在执法与问责方面，香港警方及廉政公署至今共起诉了涉事承建商、工程顾问相关的七人及两家公司，涉及共25项控罪，包括误杀、串谋诈骗、洗黑钱、企图妨碍司法公正及逃税等，案件将于明年1月14日提讯。 香港劳工处已向一人及两家公司提出合共25项检控，涉嫌违反职安健法例，案件将于明年9月9日首次提堂。香港屋宇署已向四人及两间公司提出合共259项检控，包括涉嫌使用不合规的物料等，案件将于明年1月21日首次提堂。香港消防处也已向一人及两家公司提出合共12项检控，包括涉嫌违反《消防（装置及设备）规例》的罪行，案件将于明年1月21日首次提堂。 一个月前成立的跨部门打击楼宇维修工程围标联合特遣队，已采取两次行动，总共拘捕163人。在11月6日公布的首次行动中共拘捕66人，涉及金额超过1亿港元（1600万新元）。在11月23日公布的第二次行动中共拘捕97人，涉及金额超过1亿3000万港元，所涉及的罪行包括欺诈、伪造文书、串谋诈骗等。 灾民安置及支援工作也进展顺利。政府的收购计划，已有超过96%业主（1913户）签署具约束力的《买卖协议》，当中超过84%业主（1682户）已完成所有业权转让手续。此外，超过73%业主（1456户）已选择了政府提供的特设销售计划项目单位或以绿表资格购入资助出售单位作长远居所。

title: Russian news agencies and TV channels ignore Ukraine’s sinking of a Russian warship off the Libyan coast
content_preview: Russian news agencies and state TV channels chose not to report on the Merkuriy, a corvette sunk by Ukrainian forces in Libya. On Monday afternoon, Interfax and RIA Novosti published brief reports based on comments by Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov. Their headlines read “Kremlin refers question about attack on Russian ship Merkuriy off Libya to the military” and “Peskov comments on reports of attacks on vessels off the coast of Libya.” Both reports quoted Peskov as saying that “the Defense Ministry is handling these matters,” but neither gave any context or explained what the attacks involved. The TASS news agency chose not to run a story on Peskov’s remarks about the ship. Three national TV networks — Channel One, Rossiya 1, and NTV — did not mention the ship in their morning or afternoon newscasts. The Merkuriy sank on November 22 after an attack by Ukrainian sea drones. Al Jazeera reported that the attack killed Russian and Libyan citizens but gave no death toll. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky claimed that a Ka-27 combat helicopter was destroyed along with the ship. title: 特朗普称若不保黄仁勋恐被中国挖角执掌华为
content_preview: 美国总统特朗普称，如果美国没促成英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋复职，中国可能会招揽黄仁勋，甚至邀请他执掌华为。他也透露，中国国家主席习近平对黄仁勋十分敬佩。 特朗普星期一（11月23日）接受美国消费者新闻与商业频道（CNBC）访问时，为自己介入黄仁勋复职一事辩护，强调美国必须保护顶尖人才，失去黄仁勋才是更大的国家安全威胁。 特朗普说，他日前与习近平会晤时，两人曾长时间谈论黄仁勋。据特朗普转述，习近平认为黄仁勋是全球晶片领域最杰出的人才。 特朗普称，如果美国没有促成黄仁勋复职，他可以想象中国会邀请黄仁勋赴华发展，甚至出任华为或其他中国企业的掌舵人。 特朗普还提到黄仁勋的华人血统，称“你知道，他身上流着一点(华人）的血”。 特朗普认为，如果黄仁勋受到不好的对待，一怒之下或许真的会赴华发展，甚至可能比现在发展得更好。 不过，当记者追问他是否收到任何迹象，显示上述情况确有可能发生时，特朗普说：“从未有过这样的暗示（Never even a suggestion）。” 特朗普说，黄仁勋不仅掌握着英伟达现有先进晶片的技术，也已在构思未来三代晶片，其他人远远赶不上他。美国若失去这样的人才，将是一大损失。 特朗普也认同CNBC主持人将黄仁勋形容为美国的“国宝”（national treasure），强调美国必须保护这些杰出人才，因为这样的人才为数不多。

title: Putin is reportedly open to Article 5-style security guarantees for Ukraine. But what does Article 5 actually say? Would the guarantees require NATO members to go to war if Russia attacks again?
content_preview: What happened? Sources close to the U.S. negotiating team led by Donald Trump’s special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner said a ceasefire or a peace deal to end Russia’s war against Ukraine could include security guarantees for Kyiv modeled on Article 5 of NATO’s founding treaty, or even full NATO membership for Ukraine. Sources told The Wall Street Journal that the first option would be possible if Russia could be persuaded to halt fighting along the current front line. The second would be possible if Ukraine agreed to let Moscow take control of the entire Donbas region. A source told The Washington Post that Vladimir Putin was apparently willing to accept Article 5-style security guarantees for Ukraine, on two conditions: that no NATO troops be stationed there and that sanctions on Russia be lifted. The source’s account left it unclear, however, whether Putin would drop his demand for control of the Donbas under that arrangement. In public, the Russian president continues to insist that this condition is non-negotiable. Kushner also said he believed the United States had persuaded Russia to accept Article 5-style security guarantees for Ukraine. Volodymyr Zelensky questioned whether Kyiv and Washington understood Article 5 the same way: “What does Article 5 mean to me? It means having some troops from partner countries on your soil.” So what does Article 5 actually mean? Article 5 of the North Atlantic Treaty , NATO’s founding document, sets out the alliance’s strongest possible response to an attack on one of its members. It rests on the principle that “an attack on one is an attack on all.” That principle is the foundation of the alliance’s collective security. It’s often mistakenly understood to mean that if one NATO country comes under military attack, all the others must go to war to defend it. Why is that a misconception? title: 涉嫌受贿 中共西安市委原书记方红卫被提起公诉
content_preview: 面对涉嫌受贿指控的中共陕西省委原常委、西安市委原书记方红卫，被提起公诉。 中国最高人民检察院星期二（11月24日）在微信公众号通报，方红卫涉嫌受贿一案，由国家监察委员会调查终结，移送检察机关审查起诉。最高人民检察院以涉嫌受贿罪对方红卫作出逮捕决定，并指定由甘肃省兰州市人民检察院审查起诉。兰州市人民检察院已向兰州市中级人民法院提起公诉。 根据通报，检察机关起诉指控方红卫利用担任陕西汽车集团有限责任公司董事、总经理，党委常委、董事长，党委书记、董事长，陕西汽车控股集团有限公司党委书记、董事长，陕西重型汽车有限公司副董事长、总经理，陕西省汉中市委副书记、市长，市委书记，陕西省委常委、西安市委书记等职务上的便利，为他人谋取利益，非法收受他人财物，数额特别巨大，“依法应当以受贿罪追究其刑事责任”。 公开资料显示，今年60岁的方红卫是陕西富平人，研究生学历，工学博士学位，高级经济师。1989年从清华大学毕业后，他在陕西汽车制造总厂、陕汽集团任职长达26年。 方红卫在2015年出任宝鸡市委常委、副市长，其后多次履新，担任过渭南副市长、汉中市长、汉中市委书记。他在2021年11月任陕西省委常委、西安市委书记。 方红卫去年11月官宣被查。香港《明报》曾引述西安消息人士报道，在官宣被查前两天，方红卫当天原定调研西安市宗教工作，并拟对行程作公开报道，以就外界指他“神隐”出事辟谣。不过，方红卫在半路就被中共中央纪委人员拦下带走。 报道也引述一名在当地经商的外省企业家称，方红卫不仅本人涉贪，还纵容、默许亲属利用他的影响力谋取私利。 “当地商界都知道，方红卫妻子、妹妹‘胃口很大’。” 官方后来在今年7月通报，方红卫严重违纪违法被开除党籍和公职，并指方红卫对组织不忠诚不老实，履行全面从严治党主体责任不力，干扰巡视工作，对抗组织审查，搞迷信活动；违规拥有非上市公司股份，利用职权和职务影响为亲属谋取利益，纵容、默许配偶利用本人职务影响谋取私利；家风不正，对家人失管失教。

cn_title: 报道：五角大楼推迟向乌克兰交付约60枚爱国者导弹
cn_summary: 据《金融时报》报道，五角大楼正在推迟向乌克兰交付约60枚爱国者拦截导弹，其中包括来自欧洲军火库的储备。这些导弹目前仍在等待最终的审批程序以运往乌克兰。这一延迟反映了美国及其盟友在对乌军事援助上面临的物流和行政瓶颈。分析人士指出，这可能会对乌克兰当前的防空作战能力产生直接影响。
impact: 五角大楼推迟向乌克兰交付爱国者导弹表明军事援助存在不确定性，可能延长冲突周期，维持全球地缘政治紧张局势。这将导致全球国防开支上升，部分民用技术和资金被挤出，间接影响中国高科技和绿色转型产业的国际合作与资金流动。对于青年就业而言，地缘政治对立加速了全球产业链的分裂和科技脱钩，可能导致中国青年毕业生在跨国科技、半导体等高精尖领域的就业面临更严格的审查和更少的岗位机会。

content_preview: 【嘉益股份：控股股东增持致合计持股比例升至73.02%】嘉益股份公告称，公司控股股东嘉韶云华于2026年7月9日至11月23日通过集中竞价交易方式增持公司股份109.70万股，占公司总股本的0.75%。本次权益变动后，嘉韶云华及其一致行动人合计持有公司股份比例由72.27%增加至73.02%，触及1%整数倍。本次权益变动不触及要约收购，不会导致公司控股股东及实控人发生变化。本次增持系履行此前披露的增持计划，该计划拟增持金额不低于4000万元且不超过8000万元，目前尚未实施完毕。

title: AI Agent与招聘降温相关，初级岗位受影响更大
content_preview: AI Agent与招聘降温相关，初级岗位受影响更大 AI Agent正在对企业招聘需求产生影响，其中初级岗位受到的冲击最明显。研究人员将约2,000万亿枚OpenRouter Token使用数据与美国上市公司3,480万条招聘广告进行对照，发现AI Agent使用程度越高的企业，招聘增长越慢。Claude Code 2.0发布后的六个月内，企业初级及非资深岗位招聘广告增速低4.54%，资深岗位则没有出现显著变化。研究认为，能够独立执行多步骤任务的AI Agent，正在接手部分原本由初级员工完成的工作，企业对新人和初级执行人员的招聘需求可能因此受到压缩。

cn_title: 中国商务部：将密切关注欧盟对混合动力汽车的后续调查
cn_summary: 中国商务部表示，将密切关注欧盟针对中国混合动力汽车采取的临时保障措施及后续调查。中方强调，将保留包括寻求世贸组织（WTO）争端解决机制及贸易补偿在内的所有权利。此举是对欧盟贸易保护主义倾向的明确回应。中方呼吁欧盟通过对话解决贸易摩擦，维护全球供应链稳定。商务部将继续评估相关措施对中国出口企业的实际影响。
impact: 此举直接关系到中国汽车出口及制造业的宏观经济表现。对就业市场而言，贸易摩擦可能导致相关出口导向型企业面临招聘收缩，但同时也会推动企业加速海外布局。对于汽车工程、国际贸易及法律专业的青年毕业生，该领域面临较大的不确定性，但也催生了对处理国际贸易合规、海外市场拓展及法律诉讼人才的迫切需求。

title: 南方基金自购旗下主动ETF1亿元 已有9只主动ETF获自购
content_preview: 【南方基金自购旗下主动ETF1亿元 已有9只主动ETF获自购】财联社11月24日电，今天盘后，南方基金发布公告，将出资1亿元自有资金申购旗下均衡主动ETF南方。这是该产品11月23日在深交所上市交易后，管理人首次以自有资金大额申购，向市场传递出对公司主动投研能力和产品策略的坚定信心。作为首批主动ETF之一，均衡主动ETF南方选择均衡配置作为核心策略，投资目标为超越业绩比较基准中证800指数获取超额收益。该ETF基金经理对权益市场保持乐观，预计市场中枢有望逐步上移。早在首批主动ETF的发行阶段，有7只产品获基金公司自购，即富国、华夏、易方达、工银瑞信、汇添富、建信、华安等，永赢基金则是上周宣布上市后自购1亿元旗下主动ETF。 (财联社记者 周晓雅)

title: 木头姐旗下ARK因担忧黄仁勋离职抛售英伟达股票，错失约1070万美元潜在收益
content_preview: 方舟投资（ARK Invest）创始人凯茜·伍德此前因担忧英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋离职后可能加入埃隆·马斯克旗下的Terafab芯片项目，于11月16日至20日通过旗下管理的交易所交易基金（ETF）合计卖出71.23万股英伟达股票，交易金额约1.069亿美元。 英伟达董事会11月23日一致投票决定恢复黄仁勋担任公司总裁兼首席执行官职务。消息公布后，英伟达股价单日大涨31.48%，创2003年以来最大单日涨幅。按当日收盘价165.05美元计算，ARK此前卖出的股票价值约1.176亿美元，较出售时的交易金额高出约1070万美元，意味着其错失了相应的潜在收益。（界面新闻）

cn_title: 报告显示：超过半数德国人反对向乌克兰提供军事援助
cn_summary: 据彭博社援引最新民调显示，德国民众对向乌克兰提供军事资金的支持率大幅下降。反对提供军事援助的受访者比例从一年前的39%激增至约53%。这一民意转变反映了德国国内对于持续援乌政策的担忧加剧。经济压力和通胀问题被认为是导致民众态度转变的主要原因。政府在外交政策上面临越来越大的国内舆论压力。
impact: 欧洲对乌援助态度的转变可能引发地缘政治格局的调整，进而影响中欧贸易关系的稳定性。若欧洲减少军事支出转而关注国内经济，可能为中国企业在欧投资提供新的机遇。对于关注国际政治的中国青年，这提示了全球政策转向对海外就业环境的潜在影响。

title: 大陆选前推台商融资协议 陆委会：台商赴陆投资占比仅1.1%
content_preview: 针对中国大陆在台湾“九合一”地方选举前推出台商融资协议，台湾政府的大陆委员会回应称，台商今年前10个月赴陆投资占比大幅下降至1.1%，显示已逐步调整全球布局。 距离台湾“九合一”地方选举投票仅剩五天，中国大陆国台办星期一（11月23日）与中国进出口银行签署金融合作协议，为台商台企提供融资支持。国台办主任宋涛希望台商台企坚定信心深耕大陆，积极参与两岸经济合作，“共同壮大中华民族经济”。 据台湾《联合报》报道，对于媒体关切，上述协议选在台湾九合一选举投票前夕签署，由陆方提供台商融资支持，是否可能成为透过资助台商介入台湾选举的管道？此外，截至今年10月，台商赴陆投资占整体对外投资的比重如何？台商台企参与相关合作是否存在风险？ 陆委会星期一晚间以书面方式回应表示，台商赴陆投资金额占整体对外投资金额比重，自2010年高峰的146.2亿美元（188.7亿新元，83.8%），逐步下滑至2024年的36.5亿美元（7.5%）、2025年的15亿美元（3.8%），以及今年1至10月的7.9亿美元（1.1%）。 陆委会指出，这显示台商近年已逐步调整全球布局，政府将持续关注相关措施发展，并协助强化风险管理、多元布局。

title: Russia again proposes requiring distribution certificates for video games, Kommersant reports
content_preview: Russia’s government believes video games should require distribution certificates similar to those already mandated for films, the Russian business daily Kommersant reported, citing sources. A bill containing the proposal is under discussion within the government. The State Duma plans to finalize the bill and pass it in its first reading this year. The bill would also classify video game developers and distributors as internet information distribution organizers. Services on that registry must store user data in Russia and hand it over to law enforcement upon request. Distribution certificates for video games were first discussed in 2023, when Yana Lantratova, who now serves as Russia’s human rights commissioner, proposed the idea. Industry representatives say the distribution certificate mechanism is not suited to video games, which change through new seasons, add-ons, and player-generated content. The requirements should also be “equally applicable” to Russian and foreign developers alike, and it is currently “hard to imagine in practice” how representatives of “unfriendly countries” would obtain distribution certificates, a source at an IT company told Kommersant. Russia’s authorities have spent years trying to bring the video game market under tighter control. In 2024, a bill on labeling video game content and identifying players through Gosuslugi, Russia’s state services portal, was introduced in the State Duma, though that initiative has yet to be adopted. title: 世界黄金协会推动首次实物黄金碎片化所有权交易，摩根大通、汇丰等机构参与试点
content_preview: 世界黄金协会宣布，汇丰、摩根大通和StoneX首次在具有法律约束力的批发市场交易中，完成“集合黄金权益”（PGI）的交易、结算及抵押品使用。这标志着世界黄金协会推动的批发数字黄金计划取得重要进展。 该试点以伦敦市场标准的400盎司实物金条为基础，将黄金纳入数字交易体系，并生成代表参与者对集合黄金所有权的PGI。参与机构可通过电子方式持有和转让实物黄金的部分所有权，并将其用作抵押品，无需实际转移金条。此次试点还完成了黄金存入数字体系、生成PGI、交易结算及黄金提取的完整流程。 世界黄金协会表示，该机制旨在兼顾实物黄金所有权的安全性与可信度，同时提高黄金在现代金融市场中的交易和使用效率，并作为现有已分配和未分配黄金结算模式的补充。洲际交易所基准管理局（IBA）担任该项目运营方，Baton Systems提供技术支持。 世界黄金协会首席执行官戴维·泰特表示，这是黄金市场发展的重要一步，意味着实物黄金碎片化所有权首次通过真实交易完成转让、结算并用作抵押品。该项目于2025年9月首次推出，目前仍处于试点阶段。与此同时，英国金融行为监管局（FCA）正在评估有关批发市场黄金代币化及其作为抵押品使用的意见。（界面）

title: The Russian-born collaboration platform Miro has a new owner. Meet Bending Spoons, the tech giant that buys popular apps, cuts jobs, and raises prices.
content_preview: The Bending Spoons sign during the company’s initial public offering (IPO) on the Nasdaq stock exchange in the U.S., July 1, 2026 In late October, Miro — a collaboration platform created by Russian developers that took off during the pandemic — got a new owner. The buyer was Bending Spoons, an Italian technology company that acquires well-known internet projects past their peak of popularity. Bending Spoons’s tactic is simple: buy a business with a strong customer base, cut the team, and raise prices, using the resulting profit growth to fund the purchase of a new business. Investors like this model: Bending Spoons is growing aggressively on borrowed money, and its shareholders even include Warren Buffett’s Berkshire Hathaway conglomerate. Users of the services the Italian company buys up, however, are far less pleased. Bending Spoons’s founders started with an idea the market didn’t need. So they decided to buy ready-made ideas instead. Luca Ferrari, Matteo Danieli, and Francesco Patarnello met while studying at the Technical University of Denmark. In 2010, while traveling in Indonesia, they came up with an idea for Evertale, an app that would automatically generate a diary for its users. Three years later, the idea had failed. With $40,000 left, the founders decided to invest in a new business: Bending Spoons. The company’s name is a reference to a scene in The Matrix in which a boy teaches Neo to bend a spoon with his mind. Bending Spoons’s founders have said the scene captures the three principles they wanted to build the company on: the power of the mind, hard work, and the pursuit of the seemingly impossible. Evertale’s failure taught them a lesson: guessing which products the market wants is largely a matter of luck, while running a business well is a skill. Bending Spoons’s founders decided to stop relying on luck. Instead of building products from scratch, they began buying products that already existed and focusing on managing them well. cn_title: 旨在打击无人机的“飞行”狙击步枪成功通过测试
cn_summary: 近日，一款具备“飞行”能力的创新型狙击步枪成功通过了相关性能测试。该系统引入了先进的机器视觉技术，能够实现对目标的自动锁定与精准打击。这一技术的突破标志着反无人机武器装备向智能化和自动化方向迈出了重要一步。随着低空无人威胁的不断增加，该装备的研发契合了当前战场对高效、快速反制手段的迫切需求。此类军工科技的进步也将对全球防务产业的技术路线产生深远影响。
impact: 对中国而言，该技术的发展提示了智能反无人机装备在未来国防建设中的重要性，相关机器视觉与自动化瞄准技术的突破可为国内防务科技研发提供借鉴。在就业与青年群体方面，该领域的技术创新将进一步拉动高端装备制造、人工智能算法及军工科研等高附加值行业的就业需求，为相关专业毕业生创造更多优质的技术研发岗位。

cn_title: 日本顶级寿险公司在债券抛售中录得75亿美元亏损
cn_summary: 在今年4月至9月的半年度中，日本四家最大的寿险公司在出售政府债券及其他国内债券时，累计录得超过1.2万亿日元（约合7.5亿美元）的亏损。这些机构选择抛售在利率处于低位时购入的债务资产，旨在将资金重新投入到能提供更高收益率的新资产中。这一大规模的债券抛售行动反映了日本在全球利率环境变化背景下，大型机构投资者为优化资产配置所承受的阵痛。这也凸显了货币政策转向对传统金融机构资产负债表的显著冲击。
impact: 该事件反映了全球主要经济体货币政策调整对外汇和资本市场的溢出效应，中国宏观经济决策部门需密切关注全球债券市场波动对跨境资本流动的影响。对国内金融就业市场而言，海外寿险巨头的资产重组案例为风险管理、固定收益研究及资产配置等领域的从业人员提供了重要的市场观察样本，相关金融风控和投资研究岗位的专业人才需求将持续受到重视。

title: 上海29岁女教师猝死 家属称她一天在校超15小时
content_preview: 上海一名29岁的教师在学校晚自习期间猝死，家属称她生前工作安排紧张，一天在校时长可达15个小时，引起关注。 九派新闻星期一（11月23日）报道，上海尚德实验学校29岁女教师徐思凝（化名）今年5月11日在晚自习期间突然倒地，当晚送医后被宣布死亡。死亡医学证明书显示，她的死因是“猝死（心源性可能）”。 徐思凝的母亲李羽萍（化名）透露，女儿担任班主任期间，每天早上6时50分前就要进入教室，通常晚上10时才离开学校，在校时间超过15个小时。“猝死女教师每天在校超15个小时”星期二（24日）登上热搜。 据报道，徐思凝除了教授两个班级的数学课，还担任一个班的班主任及备课组长，并负责初高中衔接班的教学工作。今年上半年，她的工作量逐渐增加，还在不到两个月内完成两节公开课。 母亲回忆，女儿生前曾多次向她诉说“好累”。今年4月15日晚上，女儿曾打电话告诉她，自己又困又累又饿，浑身发抖。 上海尚德实验学校相关负责人受访时，证实徐思凝是在晚自习期间倒地，现场师生曾进行急救，校方也立即拨打急救电话。不过，对于家属所述的工作强度，校方未予回应。 校方人事工作人员称，当地人力资源和社会保障部门已认定徐思凝属于工亡，相关赔偿已经支付。家属称，今年9月已收到113万余元人民币（21万8900新元）的工亡待遇金。

cn_title: 芬兰湾遭无人机袭击的货轮已被拖至圣彼得堡
cn_summary: 由俄罗斯交通部下属海上救援局运营的多功能打捞船“摩尔曼”号，已顺利完成对受损货船“斯巴达二号”的拖带任务。此前，该货船在芬兰湾遭遇了无人机袭击，导致航行受阻。救援船只成功将受困船只安全拖抵圣彼得堡港。相关部门正在对袭击事件及船舶受损情况进行进一步调查与处理。这保障了相关海域的航运安全并防止了次生灾害。
impact: 该事件对中国宏观经济影响有限，对国内就业市场和青年群体没有直接影响。但它凸显了波罗的海及欧洲周边航运的安全风险，可能对国际海运物流成本和全球供应链安全带来局部扰动。

title: Ukrainian sea drones sink Russian warship in Libya, killing Russians and Libyans
content_preview: The Russian Navy corvette Merkury sank in the Libyan port of Benghazi on November 22 after naval drones struck the warship. An explosion tore through the vessel, igniting a major fire. The corvette went down, leaving only its bow visible above the water. According to sources who spoke to the Al Jazeera television network, the explosion aboard the Merkury killed Russians and Libyans. The network’s sources gave no further details about the casualties and did not specify whether the Libyans who died were aboard the ship or nearby. The Merkury had been docked in the port of Benghazi for several days before the explosion. It had entered the port to refuel and resupply under a cooperation agreement between Russia and the government of eastern Libya, local authorities said. Two Al Jazeera sources said the Merkury was carrying weapons, ammunition, and drones. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky confirmed that Ukrainian drones struck the Merkury . He said Ukraine’s military used seven Ukrainian-made naval drones, or uncrewed boats, to sink the corvette, calling it “one of the newest ships” , commissioned during the full-scale war in 2023. Zelensky called the destruction of the Russian warship “an exemplary operation.” Associated Press sources said drones launched from a Ukrainian-controlled base in western Libya attacked the corvette. The corvette Merkury at a berth in the port of Benghazi after the drone strike on November 22 (top) and before the strike on November 21 (bottom). Local authorities said the crew was rescued and is receiving needed medical care. On the morning of November 23, Zelensky published SBU video showing an uncrewed boat strike on the cargo ship. content_preview: 11月23日，刚果（金）战略矿产市场监管局（ARECOMS）宣布，自11月30日起暂停全部钴出口，恢复时间另行通知。该政策旨在缓解国际市场供应过剩压力，推动钴市场实现可持续再平衡。刚果（金）是全球第一大钴生产国，2025年其钴产量占全球的74.2%。 11月24日，钴价继续上涨。截至13:15，无锡中联金电子盘钴2701合约报31.85万元/吨，上涨11.95%。同花顺钴板块也大涨，板块最大涨幅达11.44%。截至13:15，腾远钴业、寒锐钴业、华友钴业股价分别上涨11.4%、8.92%、6.76%。 这是刚果（金）第二次以暂停出口手段托底钴价。此前，ARECOMS于2025年2月首次叫停境内采矿产出钴的出口，当年10月16日，该国钴出口由全面暂停转为配额管理。禁令落地后，钴价一度冲高至48.3万元/吨，上涨至禁令前钴价的约3倍；后续随着供应压力缓解，价格回落至26万元/吨附近。（上证报）

title: 《全球6G发展理念宣言》发布：推动全球统一标准，探索可落地、可盈利的业务模式
content_preview: 11月24日，2026年6G发展大会在上海松江区举行。开幕式上，IMT-2030（6G）推进组携手国际组织、产业联盟及国内外企业，共同发布《全球6G发展理念宣言》，提出面向2030年及未来，6G作为移动智能时代的数字信息网络基础设施，对加速全球经济社会发展具有重要意义，将遵循智能内生、绿色可持续、安全可信、创新驱动、开放合作等核心理念，共同推动6G高质量发展。 在全球产业合作方面，《宣言》提出，在国际电信联盟（ITU）、第三代合作伙伴计划（3GPP）等国际标准组织框架下，构建全球统一的6G国际标准，推动6G频谱形成全球共识，带动产业链协同创新，发挥产业规模效应。同时，深化与AI、卫星以及垂直行业等产业的合作，扩大6G产业生态圈。 《宣言》提出，以智能内生为核心开展跨域融合创新，推动6G与AI双向赋能，实现通信与AI、感知、计算等融合创新；推动地面与卫星协同发展，实现空天地网络覆盖，提供连接、数据、模型、算力、感知等综合服务。（澎湃）
